This work explores the artificial intelligence for Footprinting and evaluates two widely-used classifiers, Decision Tree and Naive bayes, employing precision and recall parameters. The DT classifier has a higher success rate in recognising certain sorts of attacks, whereas the Naive-Bayesian classifiers has a greater rate of accuracy in detecting a wide variety of fraudulent activity. During the first stage of the research, both classifiers obtain outstanding recall and accuracy rates, with the DT classifiers achieving a recall and precision of 99% and the Naive-Bayesian method earning an average recall and precision of 98%. The results indicate that the efficacy of these classifier depends on the particular qualities of the data and the classification task's objectives. The study emphasises the footprinting potential of machine learning.

articleTitle: Smart Vehicle with Cognitive Abilities
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the modern world, robotics is a rapidly expanding and fascinating discipline. Robotics are now widely used in both business and household settings to complete difficult tasks in a more practical and straightforward manner. A lot of research is going on to enhance the connection between humans and robots. The objective of this project is to construct a robotic car that is operated through hand gestures, voice commands, Bluetooth remote control, and can detect and dodge obstacles. The Arduino uno microcontroller, Bluetooth module, motor drivers, and other components form the basis of this project. We designed the hardware of the multitasking smart car, then used our prior programming experience to code the full working. After simulating the code in the IDE, it was then connected to the hardware. We chose this project because robots have a huge impact on our daily lives and have many uses in engineering, which will help advance new technologies. This project also allows people with physical disabilities the ability to move things with less effort.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for Research Grants
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research paper proposes the design and implementation of a recommendation system for researchers to simplify the process of finding research grants. Despite the positive impact that researchers and scientists have on the world through their discoveries and innovations, securing funding for their projects remains a challenging and time-consuming task. This paper objects to address the issue by introducing a recommendation system that leverages the architecture of the system, detailed design, project planning, and requirements to suggest grants that researchers may find interesting based on their platform activities. The proposed system will be beneficial for researchers, students, and scientists seeking grants, as it will provide an efficient and user- friendly way of finding grants that fit their interests and project requirements.

articleTitle: Utilization of CNN and Ensemble Methods to Support Medical Practitioners in Categorizing Lung Cancer: A Research Paper
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Detecting lung cancer early is critical for successful treatment, and it is essential to evaluate C. T. scans effectively. To address this, we have developed a platform that aims to improve the accuracy of lung cancer detection by combining the strengths of these two machine-learning techniques. The proposed system employs an XGBoost classifier to preprocess the data and extract important features, followed by a CNN model to classify the images. The web application interface allows users to upload C. T. scans, and the output is generated instantly, indicating the presence or absence of lung cancer. The proposed system achieved a high accuracy rate of 96 % on the dataset used, demonstrating its effectiveness in the early detection of lung cancer. The system has potential as a screening tool for lung cancer, allowing for early detection and timely treatment. The proposed approach offers a promising solution for more effective and efficient lung cancer detection.

articleTitle: Real-Time CCTV Face Recognition Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Imagine a society where electronic devices are able to recognize and react to human faces instantly and in real-time. With the power of the FTDI programmer and the ESP32-CAM module, real-time face identification is made possible in this era of advanced technology, providing a creative solution for everything from surveillance systems to smart homes. The conventional security system requires manual labour to monitor it around-the-clock, which can be quite expensive and inefficient. Real-time CCTV facial recognition is at the forefront of cutting-edge surveillance technology in a time when security demands meet the limitless potential of artificial intelligence. This study presents a novel method for real-time face identification that makes use of IoT (Internet of Things) devices and sophisticated algorithms. The main objective of the paper is to provide a face monitoring system with minimum human intervention and low-cost surveillance facility. In this paper, we have used the ESP32 CAM Wi-Fi module with the OV2640 camera module for face recognition and decision-making. This technology provides security personnel with fast identification capabilities by seamlessly integrating with CCTV systems, enabling proactive threat detection, quick reaction, and unmatched public safety. Typically, the ESP32-CAM module is made for low-power applications. Real-time face identification techniques requiring a lot of processing power may have an impact on the device's overall battery life or power supply requirements.

articleTitle: An Overview of Various Approaches for Automated Skin Diseases Prognosis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The majority of diseases in the world are skin-related. The complexity of the skin's structure makes treating skin problems a difficult task for the global health community. Because of this, early detection of this disease is crucial. Using diverse techniques, a lot of work has been done in the past, to diagnose the diseases. Early skin disease identification is aided by the development of a system that uses image processing, deep learning, and machine learning. The survey offers a thorough analysis of various approaches for skin disease predictions.

articleTitle: Summarizing Dark Web Services with TF-IDF and LSA
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Identifying individual dark web services can be challenging, but several methods exist to overcome this challenge. Automated dark web services labeling can be performed using NLP, sentiment analysis, computer vision, and deep learning techniques. These methods range from keyword-based labeling to deep learning-based labeling. The proposed work uses TF-IDF and LSA (Latent Semantic Analysis) to summarize dark web services. LSA is used to uncover latent relationships between words and concepts in a corpus of Dark Web services. In summarizing dark web services, authors can identify the most important keywords and concepts, which can provide insight into what types of services are available on the dark web. The identified key terms can potentially be the label of individual dark web services. With the help of word cloud visualization, the authors demonstrated the proposed approach. The proposed method can be particularly valuable when dealing with large volumes of unlabeled dark web text data, as it can identify patterns that would be hard to detect otherwise.

articleTitle: Digitization of Physical Notes: A Comprehensive Approach Using OCR, CNN, RNN, and NMF
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: 2.3 trillion gigabytes of data is generated every day but that's today's world for you. In this technological era where we can use technology in almost all sectors and regular and constant day-to-day activities, these huge digital copies and data are communicated and accessed. Hence even though handwritten texts have their purpose and application they are of no use in the digital era. Questioning the same problem, innovations and key-to-note digitization and topic identification of this huge digital database carry inestimable merits and value. Before fitting execution, we went on exploring different methods, algorithms, and systems with our own which lead us to many trials and errors, and mistakes. Ultimately we came up with a system integrating Topic Detection and Identification. Intending to integrate both processes into a single system, we examine various algorithms involving neural networks like RNN, CNN, and ANN, and methods such as Tesseract, KNN, and LSTM that are used for implementing OCR while techniques such as K means clustering, TF-IDF, LDA, and LINGO have been employed to perform topic detection and identification. Based on our study and results from various papers, we have decided to use CNN for OCR.

articleTitle: Colour-Based Agro Product Sorting and Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Due to the growing demand for high-quality food, it is challenging for individuals to distinguish between ripe and unripe foods by colour and to diagnose sickness with bare eyes. Even colour-based fruit and vegetable sorting requires human labour. Using colour recognition technology to automate the sorting process allows organizations to increase production and efficiency while saving time and money. The NodeMCU microcontroller, the TCS3200 colour sensor, and servo motors are used to create the colour-based sorting device. The system's IoT interface uses the NodeMCU microcontroller. The colour sensor detects the product's colour and sorts it accordingly. Data about the detected colour is transmitted to the website, in this instance, ThingSpeak is used. In the back end, with this information, the disease and quality of the product can also be detected. The experimental results indicate that the prototype will meet the needs for increased productivity and precision in the field of automation.

articleTitle: Massive MIMO Technology Based Analysis of Allocation of Energy-Efficient Resources and Selecting a Transmit Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Transmission reliability and channel capacity are both improved by Massive MIMO. Hardware expenses and deployment complexities may be minimized with the assistance of “Transmit Antenna Selection (TAS) and Resource Allocation (RA)”. “The RA and TAS of millimeter-wave massive MIMO wireless communication are the primary foci of this study”. MIMO refers to systems that take in data and send it out in different ways. This research not only presents a technique for properly distributing resources that takes use of Deep Learning, but it also increases the efficiency of the process referred to as Transmit Antenna Selection (TAS). To ensure fair and equal distribution of radio resources (such as power, space, time, and frequency) among all users, “Attention Based Capsule Auto-Encoder (ACAE) architecture” is used here. The BS additionally uses the Battle Royale Optimization (BRO) technique to choose the optimal antenna from a pool of options. Selecting the best antenna for each of the UE is an important part of this optimization method, which aims to reduce the network's power consumption. The performance of MIMO systems may be enhanced by using antennas that optimize for spectral efficiency (SE), energy efficiency (EE), return on investment (ROI), and diversity gain (DG). As a result, both the RA and optimum antenna selection strategies are used to enhance of the efficiency of the wireless communication to using the massive “MIMO technology” for wireless 5G communication process. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been shown using MATLAB simulations. Capacity, energy efficiency, and system effectiveness are all improved by the new approach.

articleTitle: spryDEX:Decentralized Exchange for Cryptocurrencies using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study outlines the development and execution of a Decentralized EXchange (DEX) that utilizes blockchain technology. The DEX allows for peer-to-peer trading of various cryptocurrencies like Ethereum and Sprybucks (experimental new ERC-20 token) without the need for intermediaries, providing greater privacy, security, and autonomy for traders. By providing users with real-time data, news, and social media community insights, DEXs allow users to make informed trading decisions about cryptocurrencies based on up-to-date information. This information can help users identify emerging trends and opportunities, as well as manage risks in a rapidly changing market. The DEX is built on top of the Ethereum blockchain, utilizing smart contracts to handle the trading logic and provide security, immutability, and transparency. The DEX is implemented using a peer-to-peer network where traders can broadcast their orders and match with each other in a trust-less manner. To ensure that the order book is always up-to-date and reliable, we used the proof-of-stake consensus algorithm. Traders have the ability to add or remove liquidity from the implemented liquidity pool, which in turn provides the necessary liquidity for trades. The DEX is intended to offer a straightforward and user-friendly experience. The user interface allows traders to place orders, view their balances, and monitor their transactions in real-time.

articleTitle: Smart Prepaid Toll Management System Using RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the age of modern world all the nations are developing and in consistence with that more and more bridges are constructing in order to develop the transport system, communication, international relationship & economy of the country. Most of the country, specifically in Asian countries uses manual toll collection system. But this is a very lengthy process and because of that it creates a huge traffic jam. For a development country like Bangladesh traffic jam is a barrier for economic growth. So, this manual toll collection system is neither efficient nor cost effective. Considering the above situation, this paper proposed a tentative solution which is “Smart Prepaid Toll Management System Using RFID”. This system is an automatic toll collection process where users don't need to pay the money manually. Contactless RFID card will be detected by the RFID reader to cut a specific amount of toll charge from the user account. In case of emergency situation, where user don't have sufficient amount in his/her account, can access to the emergency loan or in-booth recharge system to pass through the toll point. To implement the propose system, Arduino Mega will be used to control the servo motor, LCD display, RFID reader, Ultrasonic sensor and many more tools is going to be required. Thus, the article proves that, using the proposed electronic toll collection system will help to reduce the problems due to the traditional toll collection process thereby saving the valuable time due to long traffic jam.

articleTitle: Enhancing Credit Card Security: A Machine Learning Approach for Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Transactions increase in frequency as the world swiftly adopts digitisation and a cashless economy. The use of credit cards has dramatically increased in recent years. Financial institutions face a large loss as a result of the expanding related fraud activities. As a result, we must evaluate transactions to determine which are real and which are fraudulent. In this essay, we present a comprehensive study of the various methods for detecting credit card fraud. These methods make use of Bayesian Belief Networks, algorithms, Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, Genetic Random Forests, Markov Models, and Hidden Support Vector Machines (SVM). There is a thorough examination of several approaches offered. Following analysis, we put the SVM and LR models into practice, along with addressing data imbalances and feature extraction. We summarise the advantages and disadvantages of the same as stated in the respective publications as our conclusion to the paper. We want to use a credit card approach that is effective.

articleTitle: Lunar Lander Using Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The harsh and dynamic lunar surface environment, developing autonomous lunar landing has proven to be a difficult problem for space agencies. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently come to light as a viable solution to this issue. In this research, In this paper we proposed that an RL-based lunar lander control system that enables the lunar lander to travel and land on the moon on its own. The proposed paper comprises of a deep neural network that has been taught the best control strategy using RL algorithms. The lander may learn from its mistakes and gradually improve through the RL algorithm. The results of the simulations demonstrate that, even in the presence of uncertainties and disturbances, the proposed system can effectively lead the lunar lander to a secure landing on the lunar surface. The proposed method offers fresh options for space research and shows the potential of RL in creating autonomous control systems for lunar landers.

articleTitle: Orthopedic Electric Belt: Heating and Supporting for Low Back Pain for Sacroiliac Joint Ailment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The global prevalence and years of healthy life lost due to disability rates from low back pain is one of the most significant factors to human health. Especially, developing and under developed counties such as Bangladesh is at risk of low back pain for sacroiliac joint ailment due to the lifestyle and working behavior. Hence, the primary focus of this paper is develop an orthopedic electric belt which can generate heat to alleviate this low back pain. This proposed electric belt consists of power resistors for heating system which is placed inside the belt and a temperature controller and dc power supply have been positioned outside. Simulation has been conducted to observe the current flow and to determine voltage and current. A hardware has also been developed with the temperature controller and the power driver circuit. Moreover, this proposed belt also offers portability, light-weight and inexpensive compared to other commercial electric belts.

articleTitle: Smart Street Lighting Control System Using PWM
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The goal of the IoT-based smart street light system is to conserve energy by decreasing manual labour requirements and electricity waste. The energy that is conserved can be put to a variety of uses, including domestic and commercial ones. An LDR sensor is used in the system to control how the street lights are turned on and off in response to the amount of ambient light. This sensor's output is a relay, and it simply detects light and dark. Through the internet, anyone may get up-to-date information about the condition of the street lights, assuring great dependability and long-term stability. The amount of light is adjusted throughout the day using a programmable board. In comparison to the current system, the proposed system performs better.

articleTitle: Solar Based Smart Water Sprinkler System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The world's most serious socioeconomic issue is a lack of water resources, notably in agriculture, where vast volumes of water are needed. Farmers struggle to maintain their fields during water shortages, resulting in either overwatering or under watering which can harm the plants. To address this, we created a solar based smart water sprinkler system that considers different aspects of gardening and landscaping, and ensures plants receive the correct amount of water. The system uses a soil moisture sensor and sprinkler arrangement to water plants when the soil is dry and stop when the soil is wet. The system also uses water level and pressure sensors to identify damage and prevent excess water flow. The automatic plant watering system conserves water and helps plants grow to their fullest potential.

articleTitle: Detection of Nuclei for Breast Cancer Detection Using Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Breast cancer ranks as utmost prevalent form of cancer among women on a global scale, and a pathologist must spend a lot of time studying many images under various magnifications in order to provide an accurate and prompt diagnosis. Many researchers automate this procedure in order to provide a quicker and more reliable diagnosis of these malignancies. They do this by using computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning approaches. This paper is meant for the various techniques and algorithms used for the detection of cancerous nuclei. There are the variations in shape, size and appearance and texture in the nuclei of breast cancer in histopathology images, there is a need for the automated nuclei detection. And it is the difficult field in the computer aided pathology research. In this study, For the automated identification of the nuclei of breast cancer histopathology images, Mask RCNN (Region-Based Convolution Neural Network) method is used. Various methods like Feature Pyramid Networks(FPN), Fully Convolution Networks(FCN), ROIAlign and ResNet network are used by Mask RCNN. ROIAlign is used as it increases accuracy of the nuclei detection. FCN helps to predict the results in more detail. The study also reflects that Mask RCNN algorithm is more superior compared to the other nuclei detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Voice Analysis for Detecting Artificial Speech and Predicting Gender and Age: A Literature Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This article surveys the literature on voice analysis. The present invention relates to a method and system for analyzing voice data to detect artificial speech then demodulate it to original speech and predict the gender and age of the speaker if the input speech is not fake. The system includes a voice analysis module that processes the voice data and extracts features from the voice signals. The extracted features are then compared with pre-stored reference features to determine the authenticity of the voice signal and the gender and age of the speaker.

articleTitle: Kubernetes Cluster Disaster Recovery Using AWS
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: As applications in IT have been spanning multiple containers across servers, kubernetes is being used extensively for automating software deployment, scaling and management. Kubernetes eases the container tasks and also other activities like horizontal scaling and canary development. To run cloud-native applications, kubernetes has become the de facto standard for container orchestration, regardless of the underlying platform. This makes it very crucial to have a disaster recovery plan for kubernetes environments. This paper proposes a system for backup and restore of a kubernetes cluster using the snapshot method along with the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) certificates of a cluster. It also focuses on automating the backup and restore operations using microservices. Furthermore, it makes use of Amazon Web Services (AWS) tools for the reliability, scalability and the automation of backup and restore operations. The user can run the proposed microservices to backup and restore the cluster from any specific timestamp before the disaster. The experimental results demonstrate the effective performance of the proposed method in terms of efficiently restoring the kubernetes cluster in optimal time.

articleTitle: Study of California Earthquake Prediction Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Earthquake prediction is a highly challenging and complex task that has been the subject of scientific inquiry for many years. Even though we have learned a lot about earthquakes, it is still hard to predict them accurately and reliably. This is because earthquakes are complicated and hard to predict, and because our scientific knowledge and technology are not as advanced as they could be. There have been many ideas about how to predict earthquakes, such as using seismological and geophysical data,. But a lot of work still needs to be done to make a reliable and effective earthquake prediction system that can warn people in time and lessen the damage caused by earthquakes. In this work, an intelligent earthquake prediction model is developed using various machine learning algorithms. The seismological data of USGS is used for the model training and validation. The system has shown an prediction accuracy of 92.7%

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Pre- Trained Models and Machine Learning Classifiers for Accurate Cervical Cancer Diagnosis using Colposcopy Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cervical cancer is a significant public health issue worldwide, and early detection is essential for successful treatment. Colposcopy is a widely used diagnostic tool for cervical cancer, but its accuracy depends on the examiner's experience. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems can potentially improve diagnostic accuracy and reduce variability among examiners. The proposed system includes feature extraction using different deep-learning pre-trained models and classification into cancerous and non-cancerous images using different machine-learning classifiers. The efficacy of the suggested system is assessed utilizing a conventional dataset comprising colposcopy images. The results of study demonstrate a potential of CAD systems for improving accuracy of cervical cancer diagnosis and reducing inter-observer variability using deep learning. The paper presents that the Googlenet and ResNet-50 pre-trained models features from transformation zone extracted colposcopy images have the highest classification accuracy of 76.64%.

articleTitle: Text Extraction and Finetuning Transformers for Abstractive Summarisation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Data has always been an integral part of any industry that people refer to nowadays. And due to the advancement of technology more and more people have been able to access data and generate it effortlessly. This often leads to generation of large text documents which often times take a lot of energy. Natural Language Processing has been a constantly evolving field as it helps to summarize the long texts and allow people to get the main data in a short and concise manner thereby saving time and energy. In this paper an Abstractive Text Summarizer built on the concepts of NLP has been proposed. The proposed method has been implemented on two major and well known domains - News Articles and Legal documents. The system proposed in this paper consists of three major models developed and finetuned on the datasets gathered from the domains mentioned above.

articleTitle: Omni Channeling Healthcare: Chaining Details, Information and Predictions for Extemporize Service Delivery
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The major purpose of this study is to incorporate the latest technologies such as Blockchain and AI with the concept of omni channeling for better and improved healthcare services. The study also highlights how the transformation could benefit the service providers on data management and the receivers by addressing communication and delivery gaps. However, the technologies needed to be merged and handled to an extent that it does not hamper the safety, security and trust between the partners. Additionally, explores the potential for frugal innovation and the role of developed nations in supporting healthcare systems in emerging economies. Overall, provides insights into the opportunities and challenges presented by emerging technologies in healthcare and their potential to transform the field.

articleTitle: Document Verification System and Validation Against QR Codes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: As the need for products and services is growing at a bizarre rate and with this shift of adopting online platforms, it becomes important for businesses to identify their customers via online portals and authenticate the documents. The paper includes a proposed model which consists of three major stages viz. document acquisition, document verification and document validation. Initially the system separates the document from its background. Secondly, the system extracts features, looks for signs of tampering of the document thus verifying the authenticity of the documents and lastly validating it against the data procured from the QR/Barcodes present on the document. In this paper, we propose a method for robust document verification system and validation against QR codes. Also the paper proposes a combined system, which offer techniques for document validation and verification, to see if the image has been tampered or not. The experimental results is described, for the proposed method.

articleTitle: Mortgage Document Requirements Across Lenders in the United Kingdom
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The United Kingdom (U.K.) has the most extensive banking system in Europe. The banks demand legal documents from customers as proof of authentication and verification which are displayed on their respective websites. But since the documents are all scattered in different locations throughout the websites, it is quite difficult to find them unless you read everything, which in itself is a time-consuming process. Different banks have different ways of displaying documents ranging from tabular formats, bullet points, paragraphs, external links, etc. Also, these web pages and their content are updated too frequently, so a one-time assessment of documents is unreliable. Also, different banks use different wordings and have different document classification categories. Hence, there is a need for a real-time system that fetches only the documents as per the customer type for the respective banks, ignoring unwanted data. This paper proposes a generalized algorithm that is applicable to all banks to fetch the demanded documents, ignoring the unwanted data, and thus saving time and energy.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Performance of Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM and Random Forest for Identifying Hate speech from Twitter Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The spread of hate on social media and other platforms is of great concern because it has the implicit to be a serious detriment to society and the country and is disastrous. The development of mass media has led to lower exposure of hate speech and discrimination. detest speech generally refers to a person or group of people predicated on race, color, race, gender, race, religion, etc It's defined as humiliating communication grounded on certain characteristics. The donation of Structure through named images, type of caption and words used in the textbook of ) can explain the causes of virality and what is associated with it. Fake news and hate speech are not the result of the internet age. Fake news and hate have been around since the morning of mortal history, that is, for times- people have fabricated and fabricated all the time. still, the phenomenon of social media has changed how, where and what it's associated with fake news and hate speech. Where lies and culmination formerly appeared on the internet, now fake news and hate speech are taking their place on social media. The thing of the design is to propose results that stoners can use to identify and filter to count hate speech on Twitter. Using colorful bracket styles, we can determine whether tweets are hate speech. We use traditional shadowing algorithms Analogous as Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM and Random Forest. From data collection, preprocessing, point engineering and type to, we will estimate and give the delicacy and quality of all classifiers and their results in discrimination quests on Twitter..

articleTitle: DeepCoNet: LSTM Based Detection of Covid19 Using Chest Xray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Since the covid19 pandemic, besides real time reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), there have been numerous attempts to detect covid19 using deep learning and artificial intelligence that allows medical professionals to analyze clinical findings better. An automated covid19 detection technique based on deep Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) has been proposed in this work by building on recent methodological advancements. With the proposed approach in this work, we are capable of minimizing the percentage error up to 1.09 on a dataset consisting of chest Xray images. By gathering more data and restructuring our proposed approach in the future, we are hoping to significantly enhance its generalization performance and make it more useful in the clinical setting.

articleTitle: Liver Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Segmentation and categorization of Liver CT scan images is very crucial phase, many algorithms are used to detect the tumor from CT scan images.. We designed a model for liver tumor detection using U-net architecture. U-net is a convolutional neural network (CNN) which is generally used for image segmentation method, such as medical image analysis. The U-Net model is very much efficient for a multiple image segmentation assignments, and has been employed in a various types of applications, including medical image segmentation and biological image segmentation. It uses many convolutional layers to extract the features automatically. We have used 3DIRCADB dataset and we have got the accuracy around 98.61 % and dice coefficient is 75.97%. The accuracy is showing the efficiency of U-net architecture, but it requires big size dataset and high processing head. So we have used Thepades sorted block truncation coding (TSBTC) algorithm on the 3dircadb dataset and extracted the features of the dataset till 8ary. Then we have used different classifier families like function(Logistic), Bayes(BayesNet), Lazy(IB1, Kstar), Tree(RandomForest). We got highest accuracy of97.82% by using BayesNet classifier with TSBTC “Septanary” version. Still work is going on to improve our results using the ensemble based classifier with TSBTC.

articleTitle: Effect of Annealing on Nanocrystalline CdZn(S0.5Se0.5)2 Thin Films Deposited by Unsophisticated Method: Optostructural Studies
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: IIB-VIA nanocrystalline thin films are of great importance due to their wide employability in cost reduction of energy producing devices especially in solar cells. In this investigation, we had grown hexagonal Nanocrystalline thin films of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CdZn}(\mathrm{S}_{0.5}\text{Se}_{0.5})_{2}$</tex> on commercial glass substrate by unsophisticated technique: Arrested Precipitation Technique (APT). Further as grown films were annealed at 373 K and studied the consequences on physical properties of thin films. The deposited films have been subjected for morphological, Compositional, and optostructural characterizations using appropriate techniques. SEM micrographs indicates the presence of small spherical grains, which uniformly distributed on to the substrate with average grain size <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 90$</tex> nm for as deposited thin films. On annealing considerable enhancement in grain size occurred to form compact and dense thin films. EDS study confirms the presence of component elements of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CdZn}(\mathrm{S}_{0.5}\text{Se}_{0.5})_{2}$</tex> thin films with good stoichiometric ratio. The optical absorption in visible region revealed direct allowed type of transitions for as deposited and annealed thin films with band gap energy 2.12 eV and 1.9 eV respectively. The XRD patterns of both as deposited and annealed films indicates polycrystalline nature of films and shows hexagonal crystal structure.

articleTitle: A Study on the Effect of Antenna Array Parameters in Optimizing the Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this work, aconcentric elliptical array of antennas is optimized with the help of three relatively new and efficient meta-heuristic algorithms; namely, Teaching Learning Based Optimization (TLBO), Multi-Verse Optimization (MVO), and Grey Wolf Optimization(GWO). This work demonstrates a detailed study of the effect of various antenna array contro lvariables for the improvemen to normalized power patterns generated by elliptical array structures.The objective of this study is to reduce Side Lobe Level (SLL) value to the possible amount and simultaneously reach the desired First Null BeamWidth (FNBW) value. A number of cases are studied and the outcomes are exhibited in a desegregated way with the best optimal values of eccentricities, semi-major axis, and inter-element spacing. An investigation is performed to explore theperformance of the algorithms based on the common antenna parameters such as the number of elements, obtained SLL, and obtained FNBW. Additionally, the statistical specifications of all the algorithms are examined in terms of mean, standard deviation, best objective function, and time complexity. T-test iscarried out at the end of this study, separately on each acquired data set to authenticate the result.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Flood Forecasting Approach Using Hidden Markov Model and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Floods are one of the most common and adverse disasters that the world faces. In India, floods are seemed as the disaster that happens often and pose extreme risk to lives and belongings. Forecasting floods can greatly reduce the risk and effect of the forthcoming flood. A large quantity of parameters is answerable for flood occurrence. The amount of rainfall and temperature are the most vital parameters for inflicting floods. Hence rainfall and temperature are used as determinants inside the look at. Machine learning model such as logistic regression, Naive bayes, k-Nearest neighbours, support vector machines (SVM) and random forests generally generate a model or computation method to label the results. Further, in latest days, hybridization techniques are expected to yield better results, wherein multiple models are combined to provide a new model. The proposed work is to develop a hybrid model called HMM-ML which includes Hidden Markov model with the above cited ML models. as a result, HMM acts as a first-class-tuner to stimulate the model. The developed model is validated against the region Kozhikode located in the State of Kerala, India which gets the maximum amount of rainfall during the period between June - August.

articleTitle: Land Cover Mapping Using Semantic Segmentation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Land cover mapping is the process of creating a map that shows the types of land cover in a given area. This includes vegetation, land use, surface features, and other natural and human-made features. Land cover mapping is used to help understand environmental processes, land use, and land management. It also helps identify potential risks from natural disasters, such as floods and landslides. By understanding land cover, land managers can make decisions about how to best use and manage the land. Deep learning has opened up new opportunities for the extraction of LC information from remotely sensed imagery.. Deep learning models are typically applied to satellite imagery and aerial photographs, which are then analyzed with the help of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). CNNs are able to accurately identify and classify land cover types in high-resolution imagery. In this paper we have implemented 3 Semantic Segmentation models namely PSPNet, UNet and FPN on the DeepGlobe dataset for land cover mapping. We have achieved IoU scores of 91%, 78% and 64% respectively.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition Smart Glasses for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The smart glass is a potential tool that could assist those who are blind or visually impaired and might enhance their quality of life. Smart glasses are for those who need to independently navigate and feel secure and at ease while doing so in public. It is predicated on the straightforward notion that blind people do not want to stand out while utilizing the instruments for assistance. The important research in the wearable electronics domain and the features that are available as add-ons are the primary subject matter of this paper. The smart glass uses ultrasonic sensors to detect obstacles or people in front of it in real-time and relay that information to the Raspberry Pi. Using these smart glasses, the distance up to the object is identified along with the identification of the image according to the database, and multiple detections are also possible. So, these types of smart glasses are good for visually impaired people.

articleTitle: Internet Regulated ESP32 Cam Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The activities around any or any other information that changes need to be looked into and monitored. This process is the basis of surveillance and can be expanded into many forms depending on the scenario and environment. Thus, to identify and prevent crime and ensure public safety, we must use the latest devices and technology to identify potential threats. Also, to ensure the monitoring and prevention of the spread of many different diseases, we need some method to look at the area of containment of the disease. A system using an Esp32 cam, wifi module, motor driver system, and FTDI USB-UART interface board has been developed to fulfill this requirement. In such scenarios, we cannot hamper human life and put another human's life in danger by exposing them to such acute and severe diseases just for monitoring. We should not waste lives, especially of those of great value to the system due to their knowledge, such as doctors and nurses, and we should try and provide them with a device that could enter the contaminated areas and allow them to see what is happening.

articleTitle: Flood Detection from Satellite Images Using Self-Attention Empowered EfficientNetV2 Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Floods occur when water overflows onto normally dry land and are a destructive natural disaster. In recent times, deep learning models have demonstrated their remarkable capabilities in identifying objects and classifying images. As a result, the utilization of deep learning in remote sensing, especially for the crucial task of flood detection, has become an increasingly prominent and promising area of research and application. This study proposes a lightweight yet powerful feature extraction framework by leveraging a self-attention(SA) based EfficientNetV2. The EfficientNetV2 architecture serves as the backbone of the model and has exhibited effectiveness in image classification tasks. By incorporating self-attention mechanisms, the model can capture spatial relationships within remote sensing images, enhancing its accuracy and efficiency in flood detection. The model was trained and assessed using the SEN12-FLOOD dataset, and the outcomes demonstrate that the suggested framework exhibits enhanced flood detection performance, achieving an accuracy of 95.9%.

articleTitle: GesturePitch: A Smart Presentation System Utilizing Hand Gestures
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Traditional method of handling presentations is using devices like mouse and keyboard. Later on it is improvised with new technique based on gesture recognition. These gesture-controlled presentation systems have limitations, such as the requirement of appropriate lighting conditions and backgrounds, additional hardware devices, and powerful processors. These systems may also face challenges in accurately detecting the presenter's gestures in the presence of obstructions. Hence system is designed called GesturePitch. This system addresses the limitations of existing systems by providing real-time background replacement and eliminating the need for additional hardware devices, allowing the system to run on standard processors. The system includes a threshold feature that enables the presenter to set a distance beyond which the system will not detect any hands, making it easier for the system to identify the presenter's hand even in the presence of obstructions. OpenCV and TensorFlow libraries and packages such as mediaPipe, SelfSegmentation, HandDetection module, etc. are used to implement the system. By addressing these limitations, GesturePitch provides a more accessible approach to controlling presentations and allows individuals with disabilities to deliver presentations without assistance, promoting inclusivity and diversity in professional and educational settings. Additionally, it promotes inclusivity and diversity by allowing people with different abilities to participate in professional and educational settings.

articleTitle: Impact of Toss on the Result of IPL Matches Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cricket is by far the most popular sport in India and is played virtually everywhere. The Indian Premier League (IPL) is a professional men's Twenty20 cricket tournament contested by 10 clubs based in 10 distinct Indian cities. In 2007, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) founded the division. Cricket match results are largely influenced by a number of key variables, including the toss, home field advantage, previous results, the location, the team's current form, and the players. However, we focused on the most important factor because it has the greatest impact on all other factors. The primary objective of this paper is to determine whether a team's decision to win the coin toss affects its odds of winning the game. If so, by what percentage does it change? We have conducted a thorough research on the winning percentage of the team that won the toss using a variety of algorithms. The supervised machine learning techniques k-nearest neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes, Decision trees, support vector machines (SVM), and random forests have all been implemented. We found that KNN had the best accuracy, at 76%, while Naive Bayes had the lowest accuracy, at 60%. According to the findings of this study, the team that wins the coin toss has about 80% of the odds of winning the game since they get to choose the criteria based on their strengths and side advantages. Additionally, other cricket formats include the One-Day International (ODI), Champion League and many more tournaments.

articleTitle: Attention U-Net for Low Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Image enhancement has been a very significant part of computer vision. The image captured in low light has a poor quality and includes a lot of noise which has a negative impact on various learning models. In the past decade, Artificial Intelligence technology has advanced more rapidly than ever, and a wide range of its applications, including autonomous vehicles, AR, VR, speech recognition, picture identification demands enhancement of images. Currently, the available methods give promising results with optimally lit images but have a poor performance against low-light images. The image captured in low light has a poor quality and includes a lot of noise which degrades the performance of vision-based algorithms. To make the details buried in the image more prominent, reducing the noise and blur from the image is crucial. The advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous techniques to improve the image quality under dim light. A great deal of research has been devoted to this in the past to boost the quality of images clicked in low light conditions. Numerous deep learning-based approaches are proposed to solve the issue. This paper presents a thorough survey of deep learning-based models and improves an attention-based convolution network - Attention U-Net aimed at improving image perception and interpretability in an environment with poor illumination.

articleTitle: Bookbuddy: A Mood Based Book Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nowadays, with the abundance of books available, readers often struggle to find books that align with their personal interests and moods. This paper proposes a personalized reading system that leverages machine learning techniques to provide book recommendations based on users' individual preferences and emotional states. The system integrates popularity-based, collaborative, and mood-based filtering approaches to generate highly personalized recommendations that cater to users' unique reading interests and mood. To facilitate user engagement and interaction, the system incorporates a database of books, reviews, and ratings, and allows users to access E-Books for free and purchase hard copies if desired. The paper outlines the system's design and implementation, highlighting its potential to improve users' reading experience and encourage exploration of new books and authors. The proposed system represents a significant contribution to the field of personalized recommendation systems and demonstrates the effectiveness of machine learning techniques in generating tailored recommendations.

articleTitle: Combining Multiple Feature Extraction and Classification Methods to Study Performance of Handwritten Sanskrit Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The recognition of Sanskrit handwriting has been found to be one of the most challenging research topics. The Sanskrit language is written using the Devanagari Script. In this paper, we implemented novel algorithm to recognize handwritten characters using four different feature extraction methods, resizing the image, Canny Edge detection, Hybrid Discrete Wavelet-Discrete Cosine Transform (DWT-DCT), Histogram of oriented Gradients (HOG). Classification is done by using support vector machine with cubic kenrel and neural network with ReLU activation function. When features are extracted by HOG, the SVM provides classification accuracy of 97.10% while the neural network provides 91.40%. SVM has been found to provide superior classification than neural networks for all feature extraction strategies.

Author Keywords: Hybrid Discrete Wavelet - Discrete Cosine Transform

articleTitle: Enhancement of Palm Leaf Manuscripts Images Using Deep SegNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Preserving historical documents is crucial for protecting cultural heritage and ensuring that important information is accessible to future generations. Binarization is crucial in digitizing and restoring degraded manuscripts, particularly palm leaf manuscripts. It helps enhance quality by removing noise, improving contrast, and retaining text. This work proposes a semantic segmentation-based approach for binarizing palm leaf manuscripts using SegNet, a convolutional neural network architecture. Our approach accurately segments text from the background of the manuscript, enabling quality binarization. The suggested method demonstrated an accuracy of about 85% when testing was done on a dataset of palm leaf manuscript images. The method has significant implications for the preservation and digitization of historical documents as palm leaf manuscripts are vulnerable to degradation due to their fragile nature and age. By accurately binarizing palm leaf manuscripts, the approach can help to ensure that these valuable cultural artifacts are accessible to researchers and the public for years to come.

articleTitle: Analyzing Data Scientist Salaries Dataset Through Machine Learning Algorithms Using Tool “Orange”
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The buzz surrounding artificial intelligence has made machine learning a hot topic right now. Although there are many tools for visualising data, scripting languages are primarily used for model training. The Orange Data Mining tool gives you a lot of ways to change how data is preprocessed, how it is displayed, how models are trained, and how models are tested. In order to establish which strategy has the best Classification Accuracy and Precision, the proposed research uses machine learning techniques to predict the size of an organization based on a variety of parameters, including employee experience, income, job type, employee type, etc. The effectiveness of various machine learning techniques, including Naive Bayes, random forests, support vector machines, neural network, logistic regression, was evaluated. Classification Accuracy evaluations are performed by cross validation. For this paper, we consulted the Kaggle dataset.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis of Stock Market using Data Science and its tools
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents a technical analysis approach for the stock market using data science and its associated tools. The objective is to develop a systematic framework that leverages data science techniques to analyze stock market data and make informed investment decisions. The proposed methodology involves data collection, preprocessing, feature engineering, and the application of various machine learning algorithms for predicting stock prices and identifying potential trading opportunities. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of data science in enhancing traditional technical analysis methods and provides insights into the potential benefits of integrating data-driven approaches into stock market analysis. Experimental results on historical stock data validate the proposed approach's accuracy and highlight its potential for improving investment strategies.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Classification Using ANN and ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Millions of individuals throughout the world are impacted by the significant health issue known as breast cancer. To improve patient outcomes, breast cancer must be identified early and correctly diagnosed. In this study, we used TensorFlow to create an artificial neural network (ANN) model to categorise breast cancer. To compare with our ANN model, we also employed seven alternative ML classifiers as basis models, including Line SNM, LR, KNN, NB, DT, RF, and Gradient Booster. For each model, we determined the precision, accuracy, recall, and F1 score. To improve performance, we ensembled all the classifiers. Each classifier's accuracy was analysed and contrasted, and the classification performance was demonstrated via a confusion matrix. Our results show that the ANN have given an accuracy of 97% and the ML model achieved the highest accuracy of 98.8% using LR, followed by SVM with 97.7%, KNN with 96.7%, RF with 95.6%, DT with 95.4%, NB with 95.3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and Gradient Booster with 94.2% The ensemble model gave the overall accuracy to 97.7%. These findings indicate that our proposed ANN model and ensemble approach are effective but LR gave the highest accuracy in classifying breast cancer and can serve as a useful tool for clinicians and researchers in this field.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security Technique for Adhoc Transmission Using Hyper Elliptic Curve
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The popular cryptosystem technology with a realistic way to a highly secure and a smaller encryption bit size is known as Hyper Elliptical Curve Cryptography (HECC). The key-agreement issue is a significant drawback in the crucial demand for an explanation. A secret key must be disseminated among the clients to protect group-based data transfer in a distributed architecture. A revolutionary dynamic group secret key control is present to establish effective key distribution and administration. This article suggests key-agreement architecture based on hyperelliptic curve cryptography. The concept of the strategy, in this case, is to split a large group into multiple segments, with each segment preserving its security code to regulate the segment and managing numerous segments using a HECC management algorithm based on the Key Agreement. The study introduces a novel approach to collective key generation with encryption. An architecture for mobile networks using the Key Agreement-based HECC for Encryption (KAHECCE) suggested algorithm were simulating in contrast to the traditional techniques currently used for MANETs. KAHECCS outperforms prior methods in terms of throughput efficiency while demonstrating sophisticated key exchange characteristics without sacrificing overhead or storage costs.

articleTitle: Herbal Leaf Classification using RCNN, Fast RCNN, Faster RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Herbal leaf classification is an important task in botany and pharmacology with the increasing demand for natural remedies, accurate identification and classification of herbal leaves is crucial for their safe and effective use. In recent years, advances in digital imaginative and system studying techniques has provided promising results in automating this task. The focus of this work is to provide a thorough comprehensive examination on herbal leaf, which is manually collected 4 different classes each class contains 2 different subclasses that is Betel leaf- Mysore Betel leaf and Ambadi Betel leaf, Tulsi- Rama Tusli and Krishna Tulsi, Spinach- Red Spinach and Green Spinach, Hibiscus- Multi Layer Hibiscus and single layer hibiscus. Then, we tried out the existing hierarchical learning models including CNN, RNN, LSTM, and BILSTM to determine better extract and also we used RCNN, Fast RCNN, Faster RCNN object detection algorithm with model relevant features from herbal leaf images, leading to improved accuracy and speed of classification with comparative study. Overall, this paper contributes valuable insights into the current state of research which only considers a limited number of deep learning models such as Convolution neural network, RNN, BILSTM along with Long Short-Term Memory which did not compare a suggested approach to other modern day techniques or models. So, a comparative analysis with other methods like RCNN, Fast RCNN and Faster RCNN are all object detection algorithms based on deep learning that can be used to classify leaf images which are all able to detect objects even when they are partially occluded, making them effective for identifying individual leaves will help to assess the success of the suggested method is to figure out its effectiveness and its limitations on herbal leaf classification.

articleTitle: Wireless Visual Sensor Network Application in Monitoring and Detection of Agricultural Crop Diseases: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Agricultural farming has become increasingly challenging as a result of environmental changes because of the development of pests and diseases that prevent the growth of crops. It's critical to identify any disease early on; before the damaged plants are given the necessary treatment, to guarantee the crops grow healthily and properly. It makes sense to have an automated system because manual disease detection requires a lot of time and labor. Wireless Visual Sensor Network has become an important aspect of the agricultural sector for monitoring and detecting diseases on crops. In WVSN, sensor nodes assembled with cameras are used to gather, analyze, and transmit image and video data using a variety of wireless protocols. Visual data collection is far larger and more complex than it is for standard wireless sensor networks, necessitating the need of intelligent framework design. In this paper, we review currently available hardware platforms, advances in visual sensor deployment, and coverage in WVSNs. This review also focuses on available wireless communication protocols used for visual monitoring and disease detection in agriculture. We conclude that WVSN is an open research area that needs to be focused on agricultural applications with real-time implementation.

articleTitle: IoT Based Fruit Quality Inspection and Lifespan Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Fruits are an essential source of nutrients, but their quality depends heavily on their freshness and shelf life, which can be impacted by various external factors. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the decay of fruits and the development of a lifespan detection system that integrates a Raspberry Pi Pico, a DHT-11 sensor for capturing real-time temperature and humidity of fruits, and an MQ-4 methane gas detector sensor to estimate methane gas emissions from spoiled fruits. Then data storage and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are used to accurately predict the expiration date of fruits. The proposed system focuses on measuring some crucial elements that essentially identify the spoilage state of fruit and are transmitted to a local database using a NodeMCU ESP8266. The collected data is then used to predict the expiration date of the fruit using a suggested equation with high accuracy and reliability. By accumulating necessary information about the temperature, humidity, and methane emission of fruit, this paper illustrates a graphical representation of real-time data with an approximate lifespan of the fruit. The system is cost- effective, user-friendly, and useful in warehouses, cold storage, and food quality inspection sectors. With further research and development, the proposed system can be extended to detect the lifespan and expiration of other perishable items, thus providing a comprehensive solution for food preservation and safety.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Crop Leaf Disease Identification Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: World Population is increasing drastically and is expected to be around 12.3 billion in 2100. With the increase in population, it becomes important to foster the basic needs of mankind suitably. To withstand larger food requirements, getting higher crop yields is important. However, challenges like crop diseases, environmental factors like soil type, soil moisture, nutrient contents in soil, climate change, etc., affect various crop yields severely. The modern technologies can help in minimizing the adverse effects of these factors on crop yields. The advent of advanced automation techniques in Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) can help in automated detection of crop diseases more accurately. However, use of such automated techniques face several challenges. Current study attempts to present a systematic literature review (SLR) of the existing body of knowledge in crop disease recognition & classification using automated techniques. The review followed PRISMA guidelines & searched four major databases with a comprehensive search query. 60 relevant research studies were identified after filtering through systematic inclusion & exclusion criteria for further analysis. Each research article is examined for the crop species used, the dataset used, & the methodology used. In each of the studied research papers, we looked at the performance measures utilized to assess the overall acquired findings for crop disease diagnosis & classification. It is observed that such systems have great potential to improve food security & agricultural productivity. However, more research is needed to overcome the challenges & limitations of the current methods and to ensure their validity & reliability in different settings and platforms. The readers of this study could acquire challenges faced by researchers in automated crop disease identification systems & their potential solutions to improve the performance of advanced algorithms.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Navigation in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: One of the most challenging problems in robotics and autonomous vehicles is autonomous navigation in complex and dynamic environments. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), which enables agents to learn complicated behaviors autonomously through trial and error, has demonstrated that it has the potential to be an effective solution to this problem. By utilizing the Waymo open dataset and the Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) algorithm, this research paper aims to investigate the potential of DRL for autonomous navigation in complex environments. In the first step of this process, we conduct a literature review that focuses on numerous research that has studied the application of DRL for autonomous navigation in various settings. After that, we discuss our methodology, which entails utilizing PPO to instruct an agent navigating the Waymo dataset. According to the findings of our study, the trained agent can properly navigate through the environment, even when barriers and other dynamic elements are present. In addition, we assess our agent's performance using various criteria, such as the percentage of successful attempts, efficiency, and risk. According to our research's conclusions, DRL-based navigation systems have the potential to create genuinely autonomous systems that can navigate across surroundings that are both complicated and dynamic. In general, the findings of this study demonstrate how important it is to investigate the possibilities of DRL to find solutions to complex problems in the fields of robotics and autonomous cars.

articleTitle: A Study of Challenges and Limitations to Applying Machine Learning to Highly Unstructured Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a lot of curiosity about the use of machine learning algorithms to analyze unstructured data, including social media posts and videos. The limitations and difficulties posed by these technologies must be overcome in order to guarantee accurate and trustworthy results, despite the promise they hold. This study examines the restrictions and difficulties associated with using machine learning algorithms on unstructured data. We identify the main difficulties in working with unstructured data, such as the lack of standardization and the difficulty in handling noise and bias, through a literature review and case studies. We then look at methods for overcoming these obstacles, such as feature engineering, pre-processing techniques, and ensemble methods. The results of this study have implications for both theoretical and applied work in machine learning, particularly in the fields of feature engineering, model selection, and data cleaning. This paper's goal is to provide a thorough understanding of the constraints and difficulties associated with using machine learning algorithms on unstructured data, as well as to contribute to the creation of best practices for handling these data type

articleTitle: Surface Area Calculation of Asymmetric/Axisymmetric Shapes Utilising Simple Image Processing and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A novel technique is being developed to accurately measure the surface area of both axi-symmetric and asymmetric shapes using 2D images of those objects. The proposed method involves a simple camera configuring model that estimates the intrinsic and extrinsic parameters of the camera, including the optical/image centre, focal length, orientation, and location. By converting pixels to millimetres using a conversion ratio, the dimensions of different objects in the image can be determined. To maintain consistency across asymmetric objects, a quadrilateral approach is being employed. This technique provides a solution for measuring the surface area of irregular objects in today's automated environment.

articleTitle: Study and Survey on Gesture Recognition Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a considerable amount of research in the Gesture Recognition domain, mainly owing to the technological advancements in Computer Vision. Various new applications have been conceptualised and developed in this field. This paper discusses the implementation of gesture recognition systems in multiple sectors such as gaming, healthcare, home appliances, industrial robots, and virtual reality. Different methodologies for capturing gestures are compared and contrasted throughout this survey. Various data sources and data acquisition techniques have been discussed. The role of gestures in sign language has been studied and existing approaches have been reviewed. Common challenges faced while building gesture recognition systems have also been explored.

articleTitle: A Research Survey on Traffic Management, Accident Detection and Emergency Notification Systems to Improve Society Health
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The rapid growth of urbanization coupled with the rise in number of vehicles on roads have resulted in various issues, including traffic congestion, emergency vehicle delays, and delayed medical assistance to accident victims. To tackle these problems, we propose an Intelligent Traffic Management and Accident Detection System with Emergency Notifications using Artificial Intelligence (AI), implemented in a software-based, simulated, controlled environment. Our system employs a combination of computer vision, image processing, and machine learning techniques to collect data from strategically placed cameras along the roads and a camera mounted on top of signals. The captured image frames are sent to a central server located at the intersection, where the system's logic processes them in real-time to dynamically adjust signal timings based on the traffic density. In addition, our system provides priority for emergency first-responder vehicles to ensure their swift and safe passage through traffic. The proposed system also includes an accident detection system that classifies accidents based on their severity. If the severity exceeds a predefined threshold value, the system detects the location of the accident and sends an alert to the nearest hospital, allowing medical assistance to reach the accident site promptly. Our system aims to offer an efficient and effective solution to the challenges posed by increasing traffic. By incorporating AI, we can provide an advanced traffic management system that can optimize traffic flow and prioritize emergency vehicle movements, ensuring the safety and well-being of all commuters and accident victims.

articleTitle: Review of Flood Prediction Techniques used in Mumbai Region
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The Mumbai region is highly vulnerable to flooding due to its coastal location and heavy rainfall during the monsoon season. In recent years, several flood events have caused significant damage to the city's infrastructure and disrupted daily life for millions of residents. To mitigate the impact of such disasters, various flood prediction techniques have been developed and applied in the Mumbai region. This review article provides an overview of these techniques, including statistical models, hydrological models, and artificial intelligence-based models, while taking into consideration the various parameters like accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score related to prediction of floods in the region. The strengths and limitations of each approach have been analysed and the challenges in predicting floods in the complex urban environment of Mumbai have been discussed. Additionally, the availability and quality of data required for these techniques and the potential for integrating multiple models to improve flood prediction accuracy is examined. Finally, future research directions for enhancing flood prediction and preparedness in the Mumbai region is suggested.

articleTitle: Handwritten Word Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Humans are the only species with the ability to recognize anything. The hand transcription is simple for humans to recognize. We have created a Convolutional Neural Network model that accurately converts handwritten words into digital text, aiming to simplify our lives. Despite the challenges posed by variations in patterns across different languages, our system employs advanced techniques such as image processing, feature extraction, and classification to enhance accuracy. Through extensive training, the system learns to recognize similarities and differences among various handwritten samples, improving its ability to identify and interpret text accurately. Our CNN-based approach holds great promise for streamlining tasks that rely on converting handwritten words into digital text.

articleTitle: Cobotics for Improving Industry 5.0 Performance in Smart Manufacturing Through the Lens of Resource Based View
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Industry 5.0 is emerging and the primary focus is human centricity with experimentation on human and machines collaboration. This study aims to identify critical factors of smart manufacturing systems performance for Industry 5.0. Based on Resource based view framework and Dynamic capability view theory, determinants of cobotics collaboration and work flow integration were recognized that were Human-Cobot relational competence, Industry 5.0 technology competence, and support from top management. Model for smart manufacturing system performance was empirically tested using responses of 302 employees from manufacturing industries in India. The study highlights that Industry 5.0 technology competence and support of top management were positively influencing cobotics collaboration and work flow integration. However Human-Cobot relational competence was found insignificant. The results also showed that cobotic collaboration had positive influence, whereas cobotic work flow integration had no influence on smart manufacturing system performance. The study provides practical implications to manufacturing industries and policy makers for industry 5.0.

articleTitle: Voice Based E-Mail System for Visually Impaired Peoples Using Computer Vision Techniques: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Generations born in the modern period have an obligation to fully use the potential of the Internet. One of the most widely used aspects of the internet is email. The most essential need is the availability of standard Internet features. Even though there are many screen readers available, those who are blind or visually impaired still have trouble using the internet. Therefore, this article's goal is to provide them with a voice to rely on.
