The idea behind ride sharing is to allow people travelling the same route to share their vehicles giving rides at a reduced cost with less congestion on roads while preventing environment through reduced toxic gases due to reduced fuel consumption. The proposed system enables frequent travelers to share their vehicles with other registered passengers or borrow rides from owners of other vehicles commuting the same route in an autonomous, self-sustained, flexible and secure ecosystem. Ethereum blockchain technology is used to provide secure system without centralized control, giving additional security and revenues/savings to drivers/riders. The trip information, including seat availability, booking confirmation, the pick-up and the drop-off locations, the arrival and the departure times, are secured with blockchain mining. The payments are secured with Ethereum based smart contracts to handle booking, cancellation, and transfer of ride fares without any conflicts. The proposed system is capable to reduce congestion by decreasing the number of vehicles on road due to effective vehicle utilization by sharing. The overall impact on natural resources and environment makes this system a promising ecosystem for future transportation systems.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Potential of Federated Learning and CNNs in Potato Leaf Disease Detection and Severity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study is the first to employ convolutional neural networks (CNN) and federated learning to identify and categorize six serious potato leaf diseases. The novel methodology used in this work protects data privacy while improving illness detection and classification precision. Four local client datasets were analyzed thoroughly, resulting in reliable measures. Specifically, precision varied from 89.77% to 94.92%, recall varied from 88.44% to 95.15%, the F1-score ranged from 91.77% to 93.75%, and accuracy stayed consistently high, peaking at 0.98. These results, which also applied to the globally aggregated data from these customers, further demonstrated the model's dependability and robustness across various datasets. Precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy scores for each customer varied from 92.66% to 93.53%, demonstrating high consistency. Finally, analysis employing Macro, weighted, and micro averages, scoring over 92 % in all measures, validated the model's overall effectiveness. This demonstrates the model's skill in managing the contributions from all classes and maintaining class balance. In summary, this work highlights the tremendous potential of federated learning in conjunction with CNNs to provide a trustworthy, effective, and privacy-preserving solution for detecting potato leaf disease and grading its severity. In summary, the work effectively uses federated learning capacity to train a CNN to diagnose and categorize the severity of potato leaf disease. The study highlights the potential for technological breakthroughs to transform crop disease control and boost agricultural output. It significantly contributes to data privacy, advanced machine learning, and agriculture.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Crowdfunding is an innovative way of financing projects that allows anyone to contribute money online and support various initiatives, such as businesses, causes, or solutions. However, traditional crowdfunding platforms face some challenges, such as lack of transparency and security, high fees, and limited control over the funds by the contributors and the project owners. Blockchain technology, which is a P2P, decentralized ledger, which is distributed can offer a more reliable, secure, and transparent solution for crowdfunding. Blockchain-based crowdfunding can leverage smart contracts, which are self-executing agreements that encode the rules and conditions of the funding process and ensure that the funds are released only when the predefined criteria are met. This paper aims to propose a concept for designing efficient smart contracts for crowdfunding, which can enable both the contributors and the project owners to have more control and influence over the funds and the project outcomes. Unlike the existing literature-based ideas, our proposed method not only allows the contributors to invest their own money, but also guarantees them that their token values will be preserved. This method can be integrated without disrupting the existing logic of the blockchain. The methodology provides higher control and transparency for all the parties involved in the crowdfunding process.

articleTitle: Predicting Students' Academic Success using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research attempts to predict the academic success of a student using Machine Learning algorithms and a thorough strategy that takes into account a variety of variables that affect students' results. The study examines a large dataset that contains information on the socioeconomic situation, involvement, and academic success of the students. To create predictive models that is able to find out the student who is at an academic risk of quitting and offer timely interventions to enhance their academic performance and prevent dropout, machine learning methods like Classifier based on Random Forest, Classifier Based on Decision Trees, Classifier using Logistic Regression, Voting based Classifier, and others will be used. To enhance students' achievement and raise the standard of education, policy decisions and resource allocation can be made using the knowledge gathered from the analysis.

articleTitle: INVESTOPAL - Smart Financial Investment Advisory System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Investment decision making is the most crucial event that every investor must be very keen on taking as the initial output of the investment depends on the decisions taken by the investors. Moreover, investment decision is not the only important factor to a successful investment, there are other factors that also have a high effect on the outcome of the investment. These include news, real time data and education. All these factors work together to help investors make the best investment decision. Investors in the need to invest prefer to take investment advice from investment brokers as they consider it to be more reliable and convenient. However, with the current evolution of technology various mobile applications have been developed to provide investors with support to make their investments. This has been made possible because of advanced technologies such as Machine Learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and data analytical tools that help to make investments mobile applications successful. Through this research it outlines a mobile application developed to make investment decision making successful and convenient.

articleTitle: Prediction of Crop Yield with Feature Dimension Reduction Method Using Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The important factor in the development of the Indian economy is agriculture. Agricultural production supports more than 70% of rural households. Approximately 17% of the GDP of India is contributed by the agricultural sector, making it a significant economic sector. The main aim of the proposed method is to predict crop yield and analyze the best model to predict the yield of crops among various machine learning algorithms, This model can certainly help farmers to take suitable decisions to grow crops and improve the Indian economy. The dataset employed here includes various parameters such as the amount of fertilizer, the area planted, harvested area, etc. In this work lint crop dataset is considered for crop yield prediction. In the initial step, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used for the feature dimension reduction without losing important information/context of the data. It achieves this by reducing the number of dimensions in the data. After reducing the dimension of the dataset using PCA, various machine learning regression algorithms such as Linear rearcssion, Lasso regression, Decision tree, Adaboost, and XGBoost are employed to predict the crop yield. Further, the best model is found by comparing the model's performance metrics which include Mean absolute error (MAE), R2 Score, and Root mean square error (RMSE).

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Structured Literature Review on Quantum Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Quantum communications is an area in the field of quantum computing. Quantum communications has become an important area of research and industry applications since it has the potential for completely secure communication between parties. This is due to the underpinnings of features of quantum mechanics including superposition, entanglement and teleportation. This paper presents a comprehensive literature review on the fundamental principles underlying quantum communication components, notable advancements in both classical and quantum communications, and a collection of significant industry use cases in these domain. The progress made in secure classical and quantum communications is carried out through a scientific methodology of screening and identifying relevant research papers. This literature survey evaluates about 120 papers that demonstrate framework, components, and industry use cases between 2018 and 2023. In addition, the methodology follows the standards for conducting a comprehensive literature review, including questions for research as well as paper citation metrics. In the literature review, various communication technology designs and implementations have considered.

articleTitle: Data Extraction and Analysis of Generative NFT Art Collections
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) have emerged as a popular form of digital asset ownership and trading on Web 3.0. In particular, generative NFT art collections such as Cryp-toPunks, Bored Ape Yacht Club, Mutant Ape Yacht Club, and others have seen significant hype and monetary value, with some individual NFTs selling for millions of dollars. With such high stakes involved, it is critical for NFT collectors and those interested in starting their own collections to have access to reliable and comprehensive data analysis tools that can help them make informed decisions. This research paper presents a data extraction and analysis tool for generative NFT art collections that aims to address this need. The tool leverages publicly available data from blockchain ledgers to scrape and extract information on various collections, including details such as ownership, transaction history, rarity, and more. The extracted data is then transformed from an unstructured to a structured format and analyzed using various statistical and machine-learning techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights. Through the use of this tool, NFT collectors and individuals interested in starting their own collections can gain valuable insights into the performance and value of different generative NFT art collections over time. For example, the tool can help users identify which collections have experienced the highest growth in value, which NFTs within a collection are the most valuable, and which collections are most likely to increase in value in the future. Overall, this research paper presents a comprehensive data extraction and analysis tool for generative NFT art collections. By enabling users to conduct better research and make more informed decisions, the tool has the potential to increase the success and profitability of NFT collectors and those interested in starting their own collections in rapidly evolving NFT markets.

articleTitle: Biases and Fairness in Deep Learning Models: A Survey on Inculcating Fairness in Generative Models
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: AI-generated images are now widely used in various industries, including the art industry, advertising, healthcare, etc. The generative models used in making this happen are only getting incrementally powerful. However, as with any technology, these models are not immune to the inherent biases which are inadvertently introduced due to the discrimination reflected in the data. These biases in data can lead to undesirable consequences, such as reinforcing stereotypes, discrimination or perpetuating inequalities. Hence ‘Fairness’ in generative models is an increasingly crucial concept. This review paper discusses the biases and their types that percolate the deep learning models and are reflected in their results. The paper then presents a comprehensive overview of FairGAN and FairGAN+, two recently proposed generative models that aim to generate fair, accurate and diverse data, including their strengths and limitations. FairGAN incorporates fairness constraints into the objective function to generate fair data. FairGAN+ improves upon FairGAN by using multiple discriminators to achieve both fairness and accuracy in the generated data while also promoting diversity. Overall, FairGAN and FairGAN+ are promising approaches to addressing fairness in generative models. Further developments in this area are expected to lead to more effective techniques for generating fair and accurate data.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of the Applications of AR/VR in Ameliorating the Symptoms of Neurobiological Disorders
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Autism, Down Syndrome, and Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) are the most prevalent neurobiological disorders diagnosed in children across the world. Several pharmacological treatments have been developed through scientific research that have shown positive impact, however these treatments are accompanied by side effects and the possibility of overdose and addiction. Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) are modern technologies that create simulated experiences by providing the user with an immersive experience of the virtual world. Through this research study we aim to survey the existing solutions that employ AR and VR technologies in the treatment of Autism, Down Syndrome and ADHD that help improve the common symptoms. It is observed that AR and VR applications improve focus and concentration among people having these disorders thus aiding in their ability to learn and grasp new information. This has the potential for long term positive impact in academic, occupational, social and interpersonal areas of the lives of these individuals. As these technologies become more affordable and accessible to the masses, AR and VR have great potential to be used in treatment of these neurobiological disorders on a larger scale.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach to Predict Trends in Future for Options
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: It is challenging to make predictions about the stock market since it requires in-depth expertise to weed out news stories, look at past data, and determine how news stories affect stock price movements. There is a drastic increase in challenges because of the fluctuating nature of stock values. The stock market prediction helps investors, policymakers, and businesses make informed decisions based on the expected future performance of the stock market. This paper presents an application of the Prophet algorithm in the stock market, to forecast stock prices. Prophet is a time series forecasting algorithm that takes into account seasonality, trends, and holidays. The data source for this investigation is downloaded from Yahoo Finance includes daily High, Low, Open and Close prices of a selected stock from January 2015 to April 2023. The model is trained on the 70 percent of historic data, and the performance is evaluated on the test data which is remaining 30 percent of data. The research results indicate that the Prophet An algorithm is likely to accurately foresee the stock prices with an average MAPE of 20.8 percent. Additionally, the model sheds light into the trends and seasonality of the stock market, which can be useful for investors and traders. Overall, the Findings indicate that the Prophet algorithm can be a valuable tool for stock market prediction.

articleTitle: Air Quality Prediction Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning: An Exploratory Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Over the past few decades, urbanization and industrialization have expanded rapidly in both emerging and developed countries. There is growing concern between the government and the public regarding the adverse effects of air pollution on human health, which has led to an increased emphasis on sustainable development as a solution to this problem. Modern industries release waste products into the atmosphere in the form of liquid droplets, solid particles, and gas molecules, leading to a high concentration of particulate matter. In turn, this can lead to harmful impacts on human health. On the other hand, forecasting techniques aid in predicting the future levels of pollution in particular locations and may even recommend helpful preventative measures. Air pollution forecasting has been topic of research in numerous studies, the majority of which are based on sequence models (generate predictions after being trained with raw pollution data). This study examined the machine learning and deep learning techniques used to predict air pollution and air quality. This information would help researchers provide in-depth knowledge about the latest techniques and future challenges related to the prediction of air pollution.

articleTitle: Identifying Emerging Competencies demanded by the Employers from MBA Finance Graduates: Using NLP and TF - IDF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: MBA graduates with the right combination of knowledge skills and abilities are assured of lucrative careers. India has the second-largest talent pool of MBAs in the world. But in the job market, there exists a gap between the competencies demanded by the employers and the ones exhibited by the graduates. On account of the above scenario, the researchers in this article have made an attempt to identify the emerging competencies demanded by the employers, from Finance graduates. The data available in the job portals are extracted to identify the key competencies expected from the employers. Method of text mining is executed to shortlist the key competencies by applying the TF -IDF weighting algorithm in Python language. The most important competencies that secured the highest score have been listed under three different domains including Knowledge, Skills, and Behaviour. Researchers have also recommended the best practices that higher education institutions can adopt in building industry-driven curricula to meet employer expectations.

articleTitle: Image Text-to-Speech Converter with Desired Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Pictorial data is the most expressive representation of an information using the graphics and designs. Mostly pictorial text data which is needed by the user are unable to access due to a language barrier (pictorial data may be in a different language) or because the image itself prevents to doing so. On platforms like the internet or social media, millions of photographs are shared with billions of written sentences. The issue arises when a person finds an image on the internet that contains text data but, in a language, they are unfamiliar with. Presentations are crucial in the corporate world for expressing concepts through visual information. When dealing with people from different cultures, a language barrier is likely to arise. This is significant on a worldwide scale. Image text translation is desperately needed there. It takes a lot of effort and human capacity to address this problem manually by utilizing books and dictionaries. There are numerous websites and businesses on the internet that are active and offering the service of image text translation in speech form as a solution to this issue. Not just for this, but also when there is account case of a user who is blind and speaks a foreign culture's language and is unable to translate any pictorial text data. There, the issue of speech conversion and translation also surfaces. Many social media platforms are working to implement the speech recognition and translation of pictorial data so that it is simple to share the information with every user of their platform.

articleTitle: Detection of Cervical Cancer using Colposcopy: An Image Processing Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The fourth most frequent disease in women globally is cervical cancer, and effective treatment depends on early detection. Colposcopy, which involves visually inspecting the cervix under a specialized microscope, is a frequently employed technique for identifying cervical cancer. In this study, we suggest a colposcopy image-based computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) system for the quick and painless identification of cervical cancer. Machine Learning techniques are used by the system to extract features from the photographs and categorize them as normal or abnormal. The suggested method Naïve Bayes and Logistic Regression had an overall accuracy of 73 % after being trained and tested on a dataset of 1313 colposcopy images.

articleTitle: Transformation of Text to Decode Morse Code and its Detection using Eye Blinks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: There are approximately 22 million people in India who suffer from various forms of disabilities. This software enables individuals to communicate using their eye blinks through a method known as Morse code. The author utilized the open-CV method to detect patterns of human eye blinking. The eye aspect ratio formula is employed to detect eye blink patterns. Additionally, an interface has been developed using tkinter to facilitate the detection of Morse code from eye blinks. Our approach in this field focuses on using eye blinks in real-time to generate Morse code, leveraging a webcam and employing three machine learning techniques for predictive strength. Currently, we propose a free software solution that employs open-source computer vision to interpret eye blinks and translate messages sent in Morse code (comprising dots and dashes) into understand-able English. Thus, this system serves as a substitute for augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) devices. The primary objective of this paper is to create a simple and affordable system that aids individuals with speech disorders and facilitates the transmission of private messages, particularly in settings such as the military. The concepts of eye blinks, facial landmarks, eye blink detection, and Morse code are utilized to accomplish the core task of capturing values represented by dots and dashes.

articleTitle: AI Based Job Recommedation System using BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Rapid growth in the technical sector has led to an increase in profitable startups. However, it has grown more difficult to keep up with the abundance of suitable job openings at leading industry firms. Due to this, important deadlines and career possibilities may be missed. In order to give users more accurate and customized job recommendations, this research paper addresses the advantages of using web scraping tools and machine learning algorithms in job recommendation systems. The proposed job recommendation system combines web scraping and natural language processing (NLP) algorithms. It extracts job details from a well-known Indian job portal for IT jobs using a customized web scraping service, preprocesses the data, and then uses the BERT model to create embeddings for job and user profiles. Based on user input, the system creates ten job recommendations and embeds job descriptions and relevant keywords using the Universal Sentence Encoder. The benefits of implementing such a system are highlighted in the study, including improved job recommendation accuracy and the capacity to customize work recommendations based on user profiles.

articleTitle: Personality Prediction Using ML and NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Estimating a person's personality is essential in understanding how they manage stress, lead, communicate, collaborate, and influence others. One of the critical factors that affect how people interact with their environment is their personality. This project aims to utilize machine learning and also natural language processing techniques to predict the personality of students based on a questionnaire. The system analyzes the user's personality in the database, which already records personality traits. The system then identifies the user's personality based on the MBTI model, a widely used personality model. This project's significance lies in the capability of the system to aid students, teachers, and businesses in identifying students' personalities to plan their actions better. The ML and NLP techniques implemented in this system can categorize or anticipate students' personalities, thus assisting businesses in their hiring process.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture: A Compendium of Image-Based Learning Algorithms for Plant Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the lives of humans, agriculture is incredibly vital and is a backbone of every national economy. Agriculture in India is crucial because of the nation's speedy population growth and increased food consumption. Plant leaf diseases are a major cause of decreased yield and lower farmer revenue. Experts are currently putting great effort into creating a system that can recognize plant diseases automatically. The existence of bacterial, viral, and fungal infections exerts a substantial influence on reduced crop yields. Early diagnosis of plant leaf diseases is essential since they influence the growth of the particular species. The use of Artificial Intelligence is growing across many sectors to automate tasks and increase productivity. Plant leaf diseases have been identified and categorized using numerous Machine Learning models, however, recent progress in a subset of Machine Learning known as Deep Learning appear to offer tremendous promise for improved accuracy in this area of research. In this research study, various studies on plant leaf diseases are analyzed based on significant parameters like dataset used, plant names, different Machine Learning and Deep Learning models utilized, different disease types detected and overall accuracy achieved by the model. Even though numerous studies have already produced plant disease detection systems the proposed technique with convolutional neural networks (CNN) performs better.

articleTitle: Real-Time Clickstream Data Processing and Visualization Using Apache Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the modern digital generation, clickstream data analytics is a crucial component of online selling and purchasing platforms. It offers useful information for enhancing user experience, conversion rates, website design, and keeping track of the success of digital marketing efforts. A data warehouse is required to store and analyze clickstream data, which requires a lengthy and complex ETL process. Two of the leading large data processing tools and distributed streaming systems are Spark and Kafka. This paper presents a comprehensive examination of recent research pertaining to clickstream data analytics, real-time data visualization, data lifecycle management utilizing Apache technologies. Based on the review, the paper proposes an architecture that can aid organizations and local merchants in effectively visualizing the performance of their products. This paper provides a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners seeking to explore the latest developments in their future work.

articleTitle: From Data to Decisions: Big Data Analytics in Action
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the age of data-driven decision making, big data analytics has become a crucial area of study and application. Organisations are increasingly resorting to big data analytics to get important insights, gain a competitive edge, and spur innovation as a result of the surge in data from numerous sources, including social media, loT devices, and transactional records. We present a thorough analysis of the major theories, techniques, and applications of big data analytics in this research article. This research paper also present Big Data Analytics case study. We go over the difficulties and possibilities presented by big data analytics, emphasise the current status of study and use, and suggest future lines of inquiry.

articleTitle: Selection of Technical Indicators for Stock Market Prediction: Correlation Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This article examines the importance of feature selection in analyzing the stock market using technical indicators. With the large volume of data available, identifying relevant and informative features is essential for effective analysis and prediction. In this study, an approach based on correlation coefficients is proposed to address this challenge. This method uses correlation coefficients to measure the strength relationship between various technical indicators and stock price movements. By calculating the correlation coefficient for each pair of indices, statistically significant relationships can be identified. Real stock market data is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the strategy. The results shows that the successful identification of a subset of relevant and informative features contributes significantly to the prediction of stock price movements.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have evolved into a critical part of the power supply system, and predicting their remaining usable life is critical to ensuring their reliability. Intricate operational characteristics of lithium-ion batteries with the changes with their model parameter as they age, improving the accurateness in the online remaining usable life forecast is hard yet important for the reliable power supply application. We've analyzed research papers in different aspects like: dataset utilized for evaluations, different techniques utilized for Machine Learning, Analysis of SOH prediction, classification of RUL prediction, filtering based methods as well as different data-driven algorithms. The paper also summarizes, each of for accuracy, error, and cost. Moreover, the current challenges faced in the RUL prediction will be rendered, which will stand a milestone for the future investigators.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Predicting the Placement Status of Students
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Ensuring the successful placement of students is a crucial objective for educational institutions as it directly impacts their reputation and annual admissions. To achieve this, institutions put in significant effort to strengthen their placement department. Any support in this area can have a positive impact on both the institution and the students. This study aims to forecast the placement chances of current students by analysing data from the previous year. The proposed model utilizes an algorithm to achieve this. However, the challenge was to find a suitable classification algorithm that could provide maximum accuracy for our dataset. To address this, we equated our model by using existing classification algorithms such as Decision Tree (DT), KNN, SVM, Logistic Regression (LR), and Random Forest based on accuracy, precision, and recall. We obtained the True Positive, False Positive, True Negative and False Negative values for each algorithm to determine accuracy of the model. Our results show that the proposed algorithm outpaces the other algorithms significantly.

articleTitle: Image Piracy Detection on Social Media Platforms Such as Instagram and Facebook
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Image piracy detection is an important issue on social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook. It refers to the unauthorized use of someone else's images without their permission, which can lead to copyright infringement and violation of intellectual property rights. Having an app that detects image piracy can be very useful for photographers, artists, and other creators who rely on their images for their livelihoods. Such an app could help to protect their work and prevent others from profiting from their creations without their consent. Overall, an app that detects image piracy on social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook could help to protect the intellectual property rights of creators and prevent unauthorized use of their images.

articleTitle: Finger Gesture Recognition using Recurrent Neural Network and Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Communication is essential for people to interact with one another. Sadly, not everyone can communicate verbally, so they resort to Sign language to engage in conversations and express themselves using various hand gestures. The deaf community mostly uses American sign language (ASL). However, only a few people can interpret ASL, and various translation systems have been developed. We aim to implement various Deep Learning techniques to translate ASL and read the sign out loud to find and develop an efficient and accurate sign language translation to make communication more accessible for hard-of-hearing individuals by building Recurrent Neural Networks and Convolution Neural Networks. On evaluating both these models highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each approach. This is conducted based on various hyperparameters such as the Number of Epochs, Accuracy, Time, and Space Complexity. The study's findings offer exciting prospects for improving hand gesture recognition technology.

articleTitle: Safety with Technology: A Smart SOS Device
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Empowering Women's Safety with a Raspberry Pi-based Device is an innovative project aimed at combating violence against women by providing a wearable, multi-functional safety device. The device utilizes a Raspberry Pi Camera Rev 1.3, GPS, push button, buzzer, and camera module to capture multiple images and send emails to the nearest police station in case of an emergency. The device is designed to be embedded in women's clothing, making it easy to carry and use in case of danger. The software code is specifically designed to provide a one-click protocol, enabling quick and efficient activation of the device. The project's main objective is to provide women with an effective tool to enhance their safety, especially in situations where they might feel threatened or unsafe. The project paper provides a detailed description of the design, development, and implementation of the device, along with the results of testing and evaluation. The paper also discusses the potential impact of the device on women's safety and highlights the importance of such technological innovations in addressing societal issues like violence against women.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In persons with diabetes, diabetic retinopathy (DR), a serious eye condition, can cause blindness. Improved patient outcomes and the prevention of vision loss are possible with early DR identification. Convolutional neural networks (CNN), for example, have demonstrated considerable potential in automating the identification of DR. This paper's goal is to investigate CNN's effectiveness in DR detection. The suggested methodology entails using a publicly accessible collection of retinal pictures to train a CNN model. In order to categorize images as having no DR, mild DR, moderate DR, or severe DR, the model is trained. A number of metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, are used to assess the model's performance. The study's findings demonstrated that the CNN model had a DR detection accuracy of 84.26%.. The model had a sensitivity and a specificity of 81.34% and 78.67%, respectively. The ROC curve's area under it showed good performance in DR detection at 0.82. The performance of the CNN model was also evaluated in comparison to that of other established machine learning techniques like Random Forest and Support Vector Machines. The CNN model performed more accurately and sensitively than these conventional techniques. The findings of this study show that CNN has a lot of potential for automated DR detection. With the purpose of increasing the precision and effectiveness of DR diagnosis, the proposed methodology can be included into current clinical workflows. The study also emphasizes the significance of enhancing medical imaging's capacity for disease identification and diagnosis through the use of deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Mapping the Research Landscape of ICT and Environmental Sustainability: A Bibliometric Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: ICTs (information and communication technologies) have the potential to make a substantial impact on the Sustainability of the environment. This article gives a bibliometric study of studies on ICTs and environmental Sustainability published in Scopus databases. The study found 158 papers from various fields using the keywords “ICT,” “environment,” and “sustainability.” Eighty-seven publications were included in the final analysis after human verification. To determine the most well-known research issues, significant publications, authors, and journals, bibliometric and clustering studies were carried out. The findings showed that the opportunities offered by environmental Sustainability, enablers of Environmental Sustainability, and effects of employing ICT in environmental Sustainability were the most often occurring research themes. The study also discovered a research hole in underdeveloped nations. The study aims to thoroughly assess the ICT and environmental sustainability research landscape, which can guide future research and policy-making.

articleTitle: Enhancing Disease Prediction Through Symptoms Based Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Traditional approaches to diagnosing and treating illnesses may have limitations, particularly when it comes to serious diseases. Therefore, it is essential to have precise and timely analysis of health issues for effective prevention and treatment. Machine learning (ML) algorithms offer a valuable tool in the development of a medical diagnosis system that can provide more accurate disease predictions compared to conventional methods. Our team has successfully developed a disease prediction system using a variety of ML algorithms, including Decision trees, Random Forest, Naïve Bayes, and Logistic Regression. This system leverages a dataset containing 4962 entries, encompassing 132 symptoms and over 300 diseases. By employing a rule-based approach, we have created a framework that enables the development and application of predictive models. The system's accuracy is remarkable, empowering clinicians to anticipate and analyze ailments at an early stage, thereby addressing health-related challenges more effectively

articleTitle: Monitoring and Enhancing Employee's Work Efficiency Using Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research article focuses on development of an employee efficiency monitoring system. The aforementioned system comprises an IoT based wearable which tracks an employee throughout their working hours to report their attendance. This along with other factors such as projects and task submissions are included in a formula to devise an efficiency value for Employee which can be tracked by admin. Current article represents an extension to existing office management interface by including an Employee Recognition Mechanism which calculates the reward points for each employee so top performers can be rewarded. A ML based Workload balancing feature is also implemented which ensures even distribution of tasks for employees.

articleTitle: Remote Patient Monitoring using the Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence: A Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Recent technical developments and improved connectivity have made artificial intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) more widely adopted across numerous industries. In this study, the effects of IoT and AI technologies on the healthcare industry are systematically assessed. The reform of the healthcare sector, which brings about better efficiency, lower costs, and a greater emphasis on patient care, is the cornerstone of a smart city. It is essential to have a thorough understanding of the various frameworks used in smart cities if you want to use IoT and AI for remote healthcare monitoring (RHM) systems. These frameworks encompass supporting technologies, devices, systems, models, layouts, use cases, and software applications. Each component of clinical decision support systems is meticulously examined to provide patients with personalized treatment, lifestyle recommendations, and care strategies. The employed technology facilitates healthcare applications and enables the analysis of vital functions such as blood glucose levels, heart rate, and body temperature. In view of this, the present study presents a survey that aims to identify the most relevant online resources pertaining to health information on the internet.

articleTitle: Federated Learning CNN's in Agriculture: Unveiling Disease Severity Analysis of Java Plum Leaf's
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The unique approach introduced in this research categorizes Java Plum Leaf illnesses into five severity categories using an FL_CNN. The study tackles the primary difficulty of accurate diagnosis and early response to these plant diseases by leveraging four local clients (Cl_X, Cl_Y, Cl_Z, and Cl_W). Operating across local clients, the federated learning network showed a surprising performance. For instance, in Cl_X, F1-Scores were close to 90% across all severity classes, and the model's performance varied from an accuracy of 95% to 97%. Class E highlights the model's ability to accurately identify genuine positive cases in Cl_X, which had the highest recall value of 93.50%. Like customer Cl_Y, who showed improved outcomes, Class A displayed an enhanced 94.92%, 92.57% and 98%. The values for all classes in Cl_Y varied from 90.33% to 94.57%., supporting the model's effectiveness even further. Results from the client datasets Cl_Z and Cl_W were similar. Class A achieved excellent precision values (94.34% in Cl_Z and 94.92% in Cl_W) in both datasets, resulting in respectable F1-Scores of 91.75% and 92.57%, respectively and an impressive accuracy of 98%. Additionally, the global performance of the federated learning CNN supported the regional analyses. For example, Cl_X had a vital accuracy of 96% and an F1 score of 90.99%. The F1-Scores for Cl_Y, Cl_Z, and Cl_W ranged from 92.33% to 92.73%., and all three had constant accuracy values of 97%. In its conclusion, this research emphasizes the reliability of the federated learning CNN in correctly identifying Java Plum Leaf illnesses across a range of severity levels. Its outstanding performance on a local and worldwide scale demonstrates its ability to impact plant pathology substantially.

Author Keywords: Java Plum Foliage Pathologies Severity Tiers

articleTitle: Drug Authentication and Counterfeit Drug Detection Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Drug counterfeiting is a worldwide phenomenon which affects practically every industry involved with the healthcare sector in both developed and developing countries. This widespread smuggling and usage of counterfeit drugs has serious economic, health, and safety impacts on any country. In addition to this, the credibility of the healthcare system can be questioned and harmed if the counterfeit drugs find a way into the market and harm the public opinion about the pharmaceutical chain. An annual analysis done by the US Trade Representative office on rights protection in 2019 stated that up to 20% of the pharmaceutical supply sold in India were counterfeit and this has only increased since the pandemic. In an estimate done between 2020 to 2021, it was found that incidents of counterfeit and fake drugs had shot up to about 47 percent. Traditional methods of drug authentication have proven to be ineffective in detecting counterfeit drugs. Blockchain technology provides a promising solution to the problem of counterfeit drugs. The proposed system for detecting counterfeit drugs using blockchain technology consists of a blockchain network, a web application, and a database. The proposed system aims to provide an efficient and secure method of detecting counterfeit drugs using blockchain technology, which can enhance trust in the healthcare system and reduce the cost of drug authentication.

articleTitle: Exploring Aromatase Inhibitors to Breast Cancer with Machine Learning Approach Based Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationships Model Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The conversion of androgen depends in large part on the overexpression of aromatase in many females. Many therapeutic and pharmaceutical drugs, as well as inhibitors, have been developed, but some of them either don't have the strength to control diseases caused by the aromatase enzyme or they encourage unwelcome mammary epithelial cells inside the breast. The prospect and potential for creating medicines with unique pharmacological and therapeutic capabilities using the Multi-Machine Learning Classifier Based-Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (MMLCB-QSAR) process model were looked into. In order to forecast the chemical classes with the highest potential for Aromatase, The model uses chemical descriptors and supervised machine learning to inhibit utilizing real multidimensional Aromatase inhibitors that were collected from a curated database. The multi-dimensional dataset is mainly explored and visualized using the t-SNE algorithm. Despite having excellent predictive abilities, the Bootstrap aggregation or Bagging Classifier (RandomForest Classifier) algorithm excels. More specifically, regularization and hyperparameter tuning are responsible for outstanding model results in statistics and more accurate prediction using 10-fold cross-validation. Model parameters like the Matthews correlation coefficient score (0.9397), the accuracy Score (0.973%), and the log loss probability (0.1208).

articleTitle: A Prediction and Classification Process for DDoS Attacks Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The popularity of computer networks in our daily life has grown recently as a result of the extensive use of the Internet. Due to server flaws, hackers can access computers using not only well-known attack types but also newer, more advanced, and harder to spot ones. One of the maximum popular defenses is the Intrusion Detection System (IDS), which uses machine learning techniques to train on a pre-collected dataset to defend computers from them. In this paper, the authors examine the present practice of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. DDoS attacks make use of restrictions that are applicable to any arrangement asset, such as the website's framework for an authorized organization. However, it is crucial to use the most recent dataset in order to identify the most recent DDoS activities. The authors employed an old-fashioned KDD dataset. In this research, a machine learning technique was used to identify and predict the sorts of DDoS attacks. The K Nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, and Decision Tree are three machine-learning-based IDSs approaches that we propose in this paper.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Garbage Removal Approach Using Resnet as Backbone and MaskRcnn for Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A safe and hygienic urban landscape has become more important than ever due to population growth and industrialization. In order to recycle garbage, sorting it is one of the most important steps in municipal waste management. Having to sort by hand is time-consuming, tedious, and costly. In order to improve garbage sorting, robots could be used for automated waste management implementations. Preliminary material separation, followed by detailed segregation, is an essential component of the whole process. Recent years have seen artificial intelligence and deep learning being used in a number of different fields. To automatically detect and locate garbage in real-world images and videos, this research proposes a Garbage Detection System based on object detection models. Reviewing previous research, the paper proposes a new method for detecting garbage. In this experimentation, we are proposing the Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks (Mask R-CNN) model for Object detection and segmentation which is built on Feature pyramid network(FPN) and ResNet50 as backbone architectures. Also, as part of this experimentation, we are planning to collect a real-time garbage dataset for training purpose.

articleTitle: 'Real Worlds Illusion!’ Consumer Response to Metaverse Technology Applying Flow Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Metaverse technology will revolutionize the way the hospitality and tourism industry operate and is all set to co-create transformational experiences and value addition to customers. This study explores the impact of metaverse technology application characteristics and affective/cognitive consumer characteristics on the destination visit intentions of customers through the lens of flow theory. The data collected from 371 participants were tested on a conceptual model using SEM (structural equation modelling). The study reveals that metaverse technology application features, including interactivity, informativeness, and telepresence, impacted the metaverse flow experience, however, vividness was found to be insignificant. Also, Consumers' metaverse skills and challenge levels favourably impacted metaverse flow experience, but value-add search and perceived control were found to be insignificant. Metaverse flow experience significantly influenced tourist destination visit intentions. The study's unique contribution is the blend of constructs from consumer behaviour, flow, and environmental psychology in an integrated model of metaverse tourism consumer behaviour. The study concludes with theoretical and practical implications that can benefit tourist consumers, and metaverse tourism app designers, and marketing strategies in the tourism sector. The outcome of the study will help organizations to invest in metaverse tourism to convert prospective customers and improve revenue. Policymakers and government can refer to this study for devising a strategy to promote metaverse tourism to attract tourists

articleTitle: Survey of Cataract Detection and Classification Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cataracts are a prominent cause of blindness worldwide, yet only a small number of publications have reviewed the current state of AI research and development in this domain. Cataract surgery can be avoided in their early stages if they are detected in time. Computational intelligence is one of the most useful technologies in image processing for addressing difficult challenges. It is unclear which of the many available image classification algorithms is best suited for analyzing and classifying ophthalmic pictures. This overview has the potential to serve as a helpful resource for researchers and medical professionals seeking to enhance cataract identification and grading.

articleTitle: Object Detection Datasets and Product Detection Datasets Based on Deep Learning Methodology: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nowadays., the most difficult tasks in Artificial Intelligence and computer vision are the classification of category/ objects., object localization., object detection and classification of products., and one where deep learning technology has demonstrated accomplished achievement during recent years. In recent years., the rapid advancement of objection detection and product detection using deep learning is the pinnacle of artificial intelligence. Humans have natural abilities to find it far simpler than machines to distinguish between different products and classify object features according to their qualities. In this paper., the extensive reviews of 140+ papers highlighting efforts of researchers in the area of detection of category or objects and products as technical aesthetics using the technology of learning approaches., with a detailed description study review of datasets used in object detection or localization and product recognition used for the retail industry.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Segmentation of Okra Plants with Unconstrained Backgrounds
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this research, it is inclined to extract the Okra plant region from an unconstrained background using deep semantic segmentation network. A static thresholding model based on Hue, Saturation, and Value (HSV) space is used to create annotated dataset of images. A deep semantic segmentation module, U-Net, is trained and tested with camera-captured images of Okra plants with complex backgrounds to extract plant regions. The datasets of low to high-resolution images captured using smartphones which comprise a variety of early-stage bacterial wilt diseases of Okra plants are considered for experimentation The effectiveness of the segmentation module is assessed using metrics such as Intersection over Union (IOU), Dice coefficient, and Jaccard similarity index. Additionally, the segmented samples of images from U-Net are classified into healthy and disease-infected samples using the Inception V3 network. An IoU of 0.89, Jaccard index of 0.99, and Dice coefficient of more than 0.74 is obtained concerning segmentation efficiency.

articleTitle: American Sign Language Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to hand gesture detection and recognition using machine learning techniques. The proposed approach employs Recurrent Convolutional Neural Networks (RCNNs) for hand gesture recognition, which outperforms traditional computer vision techniques. The system was trained and evaluated on a large dataset of diverse hand gestures, demonstrating high accuracy and processing efficiency. Additionally, the system was put to the test in real-world scenarios, showcasing its potential for practical applications in gaming, sign language interpretation, and human-computer interaction. In addition, this paper presents a novel approach to American Sign Language (ASL) recognition using deep learning techniques, specifically Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The proposed method involves collecting a dataset of ASL letters using a webcam and custom-built software that enables users to perform ASL gestures in front of the camera. The dataset was carefully designed with various variations, such as different hand shapes, orientations, and lighting conditions, to improve the recognition system's accuracy. The pre-processed images were then used to train an LSTM model, which achieved a remarkable 92% accuracy. In order to pre-process the photographs and extract important features, the Mediapipe module was employed, and it was found to be a reliable and efficient solution for handling the volume of data. The team's approach could be used to help deaf people and others who don't speak sign language communicate. The experimental results and implementation details provide a comprehensive understanding of the proposed approach and its potential for future developments in hand gesture detection and recognition using machine learning and Python.

articleTitle: Bias Mitigation in News Recommender Systems Using Preference Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for mitigating biases in news recommendation systems while also incorporating a user's personal preferences to provide a personalised recommendations. The proposed hybrid content and collaborative-based filtering system ranks news categories according to weights based on user history, resulting in a recommendation system that recommends news articles from a purely unbiased perspective. The method of “preference correction” is incorporated to further recommend articles that the user will also prefer to read, improving the overall user experience. This approach can be applied to any news dataset that collects user impressions and has the potential to enhance awareness among readers and burst filter bubbles.

articleTitle: Overview of Bionic Hand
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Several approaches for operating bionic limbs are outlined in this paper. While pattern recognition and gesture classification have shown promise, they also foreshadow a number of difficulties due to inaccurate findings from algorithms. However, every once in a while, new methods of gesture classification and pattern recognition emerge. This paper reviews the current state of the art in gesture classification algorithms and their related results.

articleTitle: Critical Feature Selection (CFS) Techniques for Early DDoS Attack Detection in the Internet of Things Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The introduction of the heterogeneous IoT with the distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack is one of the severe security risk that has arisen in the digital world. The severe impact of these massive DDoS attacks has been demonstrated repeatedly by crippling various infrastructures, leading to major losses and compromising the overall accessibility of the digital world. Thus, addressing the risks associated with DDoS attacks has become a critical priority to mitigate their impact on the HetIoT infrastructure. The primary objectives of network security are to secure the sensitive data for the inherent application and to shield the information broadcasted over a network. We, therefore, propose implementation of Critical Feature Selection Technique for Early DDoS Attack detection in the IoT environment. The methods employed for feature selection are Pearson Correlation Coefficient, Information Gain, Random Forest Importance and Kendall's Rank Coefficient. This enabled the effective extraction of the most significant features, thereby enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of the analysis. Decision Tree, Random Forest, XgBoost, AdaBoost tree classifiers are utilized for the analysis. Ensemble was then used to produce an optimal predictive model which helped in increasing the accuracy of predictions, and providing robust results. The tree classifiers give 100% accuracy for binary classification of DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: Prediction of Laptop Prices with Recommendations Based on User Specifications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In recent years, the use of laptops has become a necessity for students, professionals, and businesses. With the increase in demand, the prices of laptops have been fluctuating frequently. This has made it challenging for customers to decide when and where to buy a laptop at an affordable price. As a result, the development of machine learning algorithms for predicting laptop prices has become crucial. This research paper aims to explore the use of machine learning models, for predicting laptop prices based on specifications provided by the users. The Four models were used to measure accuracy: Decision Tree, Ridge Regression, Linear Regression, and Ensemble method (Random Forest + XGBRegressor). The Ensemble method generated an R2 score of 0.896 and MAE of 0.149 which is best among others. Prediction of price for new user inputs is done by applying user inputs on random forest model. In the proposed architecture, an approach is introduced that leverages web scraping to display information from Amazon.in ecommerce website after predicting laptop prices through machine learning. This methodology enables to gather data on laptop models, specifications and prices. This provides recommendations to users seeking to purchase laptops.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Customer Acceptance of Unified Payment Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: There have been significant efforts to promote digital banking and payment in India. As a part of digital banking, the unified payments interface became the fastest payment system in India with its distinctive features. This platform plays a strong role to amplify the Digital India initiative launched by the Indian government. In this paper, the present understanding is enhanced through the extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT2). The novelty of the proposed model considers three new parameters namely, security, privacy, and technology proficiency of user as a measurement of customer acceptance of UPI. The model was empirically validated with data collected from 198 Indian adults. User habits, hedonic motivation, facilitating condition and data privacy impacted behavioural intention to use UPI apps among users. UPI usage habits and data privacy significantly impacted the respondents' use behaviour. The study offered implications to theory and practice for enhancing the usage and percolation of UPI among the Indian populace.

articleTitle: Recaptured Image Forensics Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Recaptured Image detection is a field of security forensics that deals with detecting the originally captured image from its reimaged counterpart. The different algorithms that have been proposed to differentiate the original and recaptured images work with great accuracy on a large dataset and high-definition images. But the challenge remains for small-scale and small- size images as the existing algorithms required customized hand engineering whilst dealing with different datasets. Our proposed system is a dual learning model, which takes into account the enormous research for computer vision and applies concept of transfer learning for recaptured images detection. The ensemble of 6 pre-trained networks, namely AlexNet, Res Net, InceptionNet, GoogleNet, SqueezeNet, and MobileNet, has been compared on same dataset. It will allow institutional level detection of image spoofing and the recaptured image forgery for small-scale images with considerable accuracy without requiring specialized preprocessing on their end. We have achieved the highest accuracy of 90 percent through our model containing Transfer Learned MobileNet and SVM classifier. As per the latest resources, this is the first instance of applying transfer learning for recaptured image detection.

articleTitle: Simulation and Digital Twin: Modern Technology and Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Visualize your digital twin residing in a virtual environment where you could test every choice, prepare for any surprise, and create your best and most prosperous existence in life. Imagine your digital twin living in a virtual world. As more variants can be explored through simulation, analysis and design cycles are shortened and better optimized results are ensured. Through the device's lifecycle, the results of simulations can easily be shared for additional purposes rather than remaining stranded in closed environments. By digitally mirroring important data and behavior, a digital twin makes this possible. In doing so, it makes tasks like configuration, condition monitoring, and prediction simpler. To support decisions made on the production floor, this data can also be accessed on mobile devices, for instance with the use of augmented reality. On similar lines, in this paper modern technology used in creating a Digital twin step by step and simulating it with simulation software is explained with the help of a case study of industrial Box Lift Machine along with communication feature like OPC UA and Human machine interface HMI. Latest modern technology for Simulation and Digital Twin is explained along with its practical implementation.

articleTitle: Harnessing Transformers for Detecting Adverse Drug Reaction and Customized Causality Explanation using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Pharmacovigilance plays an important role in monitoring safety of pharmaceutical products. There is an abundance of unstructured data available in social media and online reviews that can provide valuable insights into adverse drug reaction (ADR). This research paper aims to explore the efficient techniques of pharmacovigilance in identifying ADRs from unstructured data available in social media and reviews. This research work proposes the use of a transformer-based model for ADR classification, followed by named entity recognition (NER) to identify the causality between drugs and adverse effects. Furthermore, the output of NER is provided as a customized prompt to the generative AI model to generate a user interpretable explanation. Enhancing the accuracy of NER is carried out using the SciBERT model, which is specifically designed to capture drug and effect names. By utilizing this combination of techniques, the research aims to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of pharmacovigilance processes, enabling earlier detection and reporting of ADRs. To our knowledge, previous works have not explored the application of generative AI based customized explanation of causality. Patients, healthcare professionals, regulatory agencies, and pharmaceutical companies can benefit from the timely and accurate identification of ADRs, allowing for improved drug safety monitoring, better decision-making regarding drug usage, and the development of proactive measures to mitigate risks.

articleTitle: CNNs and Melanoma: The Perfect Pair for Accurate and Timely Cancer Staging
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: According to international World Cancer Research Fund, in the year 2020, 324635 patients were diagnosed with melanoma which led to 57043 deaths. This huge 18% death rate could be significantly reduced if this deadly disease is detected at an early stage. Although being the rarest form of skin cancer, melanoma is the most lethal and is to responsible for 75% of skin cancer fatalities. The main factor affecting melanoma patients' chances of survival is the thickness of the tumour. The most common way to record it is as a millimetre (mm) depth measurement obtained by pathological testing after a biopsy of the suspicious lesion. We suggest a dermoscopic image-based computational image analysis system to do away with the need for an invasive method of determining the thickness of melanoma prior to surgery. Clinical findings that relate particular dermoscopic picture characteristics to tumour depth are the foundation for the proposed feature extraction. In this paper, we examine and analyse various methods for classifying various stages of melanoma. We compare the effectiveness of the CNN and SVM algorithms for melanoma stage classification. By comparing all the approaches, we can select the approach that is the most successful for this issue and carry on our research using that model.

articleTitle: Prediction of Bushfire Area Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Wildfires are a widespread natural disaster that affect animal and human lives around the world, and can also cause property damage. It is important for fire-prone areas to have effective measures for curbing the damage caused by fires. Predicting the spread of fires is a useful tool for this. This paper explores the use of state-of-the-art machine learning models, tools, and techniques for predicting the estimated fire area using environmental factors like weather and vegetation index as input parameters. Wildfire data of Australia from 2005 to 2020 is used in this study. The importance of different features is studied and the performance of various models is compared for different feature sets calculated using feature selection and extraction techniques. The accuracy and effectiveness of these techniques are analyzed through comparison of the results in terms of different error measures. Out of all the implemented methods, the Random Forest model has shown the most promising result with an MAE of 78.6 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Smart Car Using IoT and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Smart and automated cars are the future of the automobile industry. With the developing technology, automation is introduced in every sector due to its advantages like improved accuracy and precision over manual handling. Due to this very same reason automation is been introduced in cars as well. Nowadays many car manufacturing companies are automating many of the mechanisms in their vehicles to provide the best in-segment features and to give the customers an effortless experience of driving their vehicle. Also, as nowadays automation is introduced in these newly manufactured vehicles it has improved the safety and security of drivers. Within this manuscript, a system is been envisioned that is an excellent example of how automation in cars can make them smart-car and solve many issues faced by drivers while driving. The setup is integrated with a range of impressive mechanisms devised through the amalgamation of diverse hardware and software elements. The configuration comprises an automatic wiper mechanism, parking alarm mechanism, lane detection mechanism, and also weather parameter sensing mechanism. All these mechanisms are contributing in some or another way to reducing the stress on the driver while driving the car The automated rain wiper system detects rainfall and automatically activates the rain wiper. The system is developed to mitigate driving distractions and permit drivers to concentrate on their primary task of driving. Parking alarm system assists drivers while parking their car and helps avoid any unusual circumstances. The weather parameters sensing mechanism senses the weather parameters around the car so that accordingly the driver can adjust A/C settings and also helps automate the driving. A Lane detection system is very useful nowadays so that the driver can keep an eye on the lane while driving, also it can assist in automated driving.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Greyscale X-Ray for Boundary Analysis of Anatomical Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In medical imaging, accurate boundary detection of anatomical structures is crucial for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. Traditional X-ray imaging, however, generates 2D greyscale images that frequently lack the clarity and resolution required for precise boundary analysis. In order to improve the boundary analysis of anatomical structures, we provide a unique method for reconstructing greyscale X-ray pictures in this study. Our method makes better use of internal structure visualization and boundary identification by reconstructing 3D volumetric data from multiple 2D X-ray images using Deep Learning techniques and N eural Networks. This research paper focuses on the Reconstruction of Greyscale X-ray images to facilitate Boundary Analysis of Anatomical Structures for orthopaedic surgeries. Our study utilizes the X-ray images in DICOM format from the LIDC-IDRI dataset obtained from the Cancer Imaging Archive, employing a series of steps to reconstruct 3D images and detect boundaries within the lung region. Basic pre-processing techniques are applied to the acquired X-ray images to enhance their quality and improve subsequent analysis. Subsequently, segmentation is performed to isolate the bounded lung area from the images. This segmentation process enables focused analysis and accurate boundary detection. Sinograms are generated from the segmented images through the utilization of the Inverse Radon Transform technique. This step captures X-ray attenuation measurements from different angles, providing the foundation for subsequent image reconstruction. The reconstruction part of our project involves the implementation of both the Algebraic Reconstruction Technique and Filtered Back Projection. FBP, a widely used algorithm in CT imaging, is used to reconstruct the 3D image based on the filtered sinogram data. The ART algorithm, known for its iterative nature, refines the image reconstruction through an iterative process that incorporates acquired and synthetic projection data. The reconstructed images obtained through FBP and ART techniques are compared to assess their respective results which aids in evaluating the suitability and performance of each technique for boundary analysis of anatomical structures. Furthermore, the same dataset is utilized to detect the boundaries within the lung region. The reconstructed 3D images are employed for accurate and precise boundary detection, providing crucial information for orthopaedic surgical planning. The outcomes of this study contribute to the field of orthopaedic surgery by providing reconstructed 3D images that facilitate boundary analysis of anatomical structures. The accurate detection of boundaries within the lung region assists medical professionals in surgical planning, aiding in improved surgical precision and patient outcomes. The findings of this research paper offer valuable insights into the application of image reconstruction and boundary analysis techniques in orthopaedic surgery using grayscale X-ray images. We think that the use of our suggested strategy to medical imaging for illness diagnosis and treatment planning may have significant ramifications.

articleTitle: A Real Time Obstacle Detection Using Camera and Laser Line Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Detecting obstacles has been the major focus nowadays in the technological era. It has the most research subject over the last few decades. There are many applications which are using computer vision techniques such as security, surveillance, medical applications etc. Researchers have focused on coloured images where lighting is an important factor for images. As per their result.capturing a scene and detecting objects is critical and camera and laser is used in this case. In this paper we will be able to take in live web cam image and highlights space where there are obstacles in the path. And the black area will demonstrate the free space available. By the help of laser line generator to assist in detecting the accuracy of obstacles through devices.
