The proposed model present in this paper present an effective model for obstacle detection using a camera and a laser line generator, on that system we can mount various devices such as robots, cars, helmets to test our model how effectively they are performing

articleTitle: Endorsement of Pneumonia using Artificial Intelligence (AI)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Pneumonia is a leading cause of death worldwide, and early detection is crucial for successful treatment. There is vast literature available for this study. The goal of this study is to study existing models from these literatures for pneumonia prediction using artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. The proposed AI model utilizes a dataset of patient information, including clinical symptoms, laboratory results, and radiographic imaging, to predict the likelihood of pneumonia. The model employs several machine-learning algorithms, including logistic regression, decision trees, and support vector machines, to analyze the data and generate predictions. The existing techniques are studied and analyzed in depth to develop a model for new method that optimizes the pneumonia prediction with greater accuracy. The results obtained through exhaustive study of literature gives the direction for the researchers to enhance the previous work and to develop state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Detecting Credit Card Frauds Using Deep Learning and Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this post-pandemic era, there has been a tremendous rise in online transactions. Along with this increase in frequency, there is an increase in fraudulent transactions. Additionally, a recent Nielsen Report estimates that over the next ten years, the card industry will lose 400 billion to fraud. Techniques of Machine learning are frequently used in classifying fraudulent credit card transactions because they operate under the notion that false patterns can be found by looking at previous transactions. But the process becomes difficult when it must take into consideration shifting customer behaviour and fraudsters' inventiveness in creating new fraud patterns. Systems for detecting fraud can use deep learning to uncover anomalies. With the ability to handle both big data and real-time data, deep learning is also superior to current machine learning techniques. We aim to provide a solution to solve this problem of credit card fraud detection by leveraging the technology of face detection and combining it with deep learning, thus proposing a two-step verification-based approach. Broadly, in the proposed approach, the user has to register using his card details and then capture his face. Then login to the system, enter the card details and the system will prompt for face capture once the face and the card details are captured they are verified with the already stored data in the database. If the verification passes then the transaction is successful otherwise the user is logged out of the system.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based CH Selection for Energy Efficient Routing in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), energy efficiency is a crucial consideration due to the limited battery power of sensor nodes. This paper proposes a machine learning-based energy-efficient routing protocol (ML-EERP) that takes into account traffic awareness. The protocol incorporates initial clustering using the K-medoid algorithm and utilizes machine learning techniques for cluster head selection based on factors such as distance, traffic, and energy levels. The protocol's experimental analysis focuses on evaluating the effectiveness of selecting the most suitable candidate nodes as cluster heads and assessing their impact on energy efficiency. Comparative analysis is performed by comparing the results of the proposed machine learning-based protocol with the traditional LEACH protocol. The performance evaluation of the proposed protocol includes metrics such as network lifetime, throughput, packet delivery ratio, and energy consumption analysis. The experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in energy efficiency compared to the LEACH protocol. This highlights the effectiveness of using machine learning techniques in the selection of cluster heads, leading to enhanced energy efficiency and improved network performance. By employing a machine learning-based approach, the proposed protocol offers a promising solution for achieving energy efficiency in WSNs. It leverages the power of machine learning algorithms to adaptively select cluster heads based on various parameters, resulting in improved energy utilization and extended network lifespan.

articleTitle: GemInsight: Unleashing Random Forest for Diamond Quality Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Diamonds are considered as one of the rarest and most expensive gemstones in the world. The quality of any diamond always determines its market price. Diamond quality generally depends upon several characteristics. The total internal reflection and refractive indices of the diamond, which depend on its cut, are used in the conventional diamond industry to determine the quality of the diamond. As the cost of this gemstone is very high, hence accurate grading of diamond is quintessential. In this work an automated diamond grading solution is proposed using Machine Learning. For better identification of the diamond cut, the recommended system uses its different qualitative parameters. For model training and evaluation, diamond dataset residing in the Kaggle repository has been utilised. Random Forest Model has shown promising accuracy of 79%.

articleTitle: EffiConvRes: An Efficient Convolutional Neural Network with Residual Connections and Depthwise Convolutions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are a widely adopted category of deep learning models, particularly renowned for their efficacy in image classification tasks. This research paper introduces an innovative image classification model derived from the synergistic integration of EfficientNet, ConvNext, and ResNet architectures. Our proposed model utilizes residual connections, grouping of convolutional layers, and depthwise convolutions, which make it computationally efficient while maintaining high accuracy. We evaluate our model on three benchmark datasets, including CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Pneumonia Chest X-ray dataset, and demonstrate that our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods on all three datasets.

articleTitle: LEARNAUT - Upgraded Learning Environment and Web Application for Autism Environment using AR-VR
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Numerous applications of augmented reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) technology are discovering several advantages for its use in a variety of fields. In the last few decades, with a focus on medical, AR has been employed for a variety of jobs, ranging from surgical assistance for phobia therapy and other cognitive or physiological disorders. This investigation aims to concentrate on the use of AR and VR in one particular Rehabilitation of autistic people. Such a methodical review will provide a high-level look at how patients are using augmented reality and Virtual reality technologies. Highlighting the advantages and disadvantages of the present strategies will help us learn the best standards to adhere to when utilizing AR and VR for treatment of autism.

articleTitle: Assistive Glasses for Blind People
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The Assistive device aims to develop a system that can convert written text into high-quality speech to assist visually impaired individuals in accessing information more easily and also alerts the user when an obstacle come across in their way. The project using Raspberry -Pi installation of packages, certain libraries to create a natural-sounding and expressive voice that can accurately convey the meaning and emotions of the written content. Ultimately, this project is to enhance the quality of life for visually impaired individuals by providing them surrounding information and makes communication easy.

articleTitle: Securing Flutter Applications: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: When using Flutter, creating multi-platform native applications is economical. Because Flutter apps are instantly converted into native code, developers think security is not a major concern. Flutter apps, like many other common mobile apps, are susceptible to security issues. When utilised in hostile environments, applications created using Flutter are vulnerable to manipulation and dynamic attacks. Hackers skilled in reverse engineering binaries can easily take advantage of security holes in Flutter apps. Comprehensive security mechanisms, such as runtime detections to discover changes or manipulation, are needed to protect Flutter apps. Even though Flutter has grown to be a popular framework among developers, creating apps without the right security precautions could have disastrous implications on the company. In this article, we will examine security practices that are currently in use or that may be applied in Flutter, as well as tools and approaches for protecting our apps. We will also study future upgrades to Flutter application security.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Twitter Accounts Using Ensemble Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The prevalence of fake accounts on social media platforms poses significant threats to user safety and data integrity. The ability to detect such accounts before users interact with them is crucial in safeguarding the network against advanced attacks and cyber threats. With an increasing number of Internet users relying on social media for daily tasks, including cloud sharing, news reading, messaging, product reviews, and event discussions, the risk of encountering cybercriminals using fake accounts has amplified. In this research paper, we present an approach for detecting false identities in the Twitter platform. Our proposed system utilizes a range of categorization algorithms, including Naive Bayes and Decision Tree algorithms with ensemble learning models, to effectively identify fake social media profiles. By integrating these powerful algorithms, we achieve an impressive accuracy rate of 98.93% in distinguishing fake accounts from genuine ones. The contribution of this research lies in providing a robust and reliable solution to combat the proliferation of fake accounts on Twitter. By enabling the timely detection and elimination of fraudulent profiles, our approach strengthens the network's security and protects users from malicious entities, including trolls, internet fraudsters, deceptive advertising campaigns, and sexual predators.

articleTitle: Decoding the Market Trends: Precision Forecasting of Stock Prices Using CNN Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nature of the stock market is complicated and dynamic, so accurately predicting stock prices is a difficult task in the financial market. Recent developments in machine learning methods have opened up new possibilities for improving the accuracy of stock price predictions. Machine learning methodology combines machine learning techniques of deep learning and time series analysis, to examine historical and live stock data and identify significant trends. In this research paper, we present the power of LSTM and CNN to forecast stock market prices in such a volatile market. Firstly, we implemented a prediction model using LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) and then compared its performance with the model implemented using CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). The paper suggests a unique method that uses CNN to identify significant connections in historical stock market data. The use of CNNs creates new opportunities for better financial decision-making, which supports more effective and lucrative investment methods. Finally, the ideology is put forward with the help of prototype.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Enabled Internet of Things for Smart Visualisation in Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Augmented reality(AR) is a vast field which enlarges the capabilities of various technological areas. Even though AR has proven to be advantageous in various areas, mainly by eliminating cognitive overload and providing a visual experience, it has a major drawback of requiring internet connectivity in most applications. Internet of Things(IoT) is associated with AR to upgrade existing IoT technology to another level. Considering home automation(which incorporates IoT), when coerced with AR provides remote access to the network, contactless switching(simply, by hovering over virtual buttons) and includes additional features like temperature, humidity detection, etc. AR is an emerging technology which is rapidly developing. When AR is used with novel cloud platforms like Sinric Pro, Blynk, ThinkSpeak, etc., exploration of a lot of new features takes place. This paper describes the concept of AR integrated with home automation which uses IoT and Sinric Pro. Along with this, it gives the idea of using augmented reality in real life. Visual representation of cards, books, distance between two objects, heart rate, moisture content in soil and real-time weather is given by augmented reality. Using these technologies in the existing system enhances human capabilities, creates unique customer experiences and provides real time analysis. It discusses an approach to inculcate AR in IoT to increase the applications. The analysis of AR framework incorporating IoT has been done in order to use it for real life applications.

Author Keywords: Augmented Reality and Internet od Things

articleTitle: Mailing Pigeon: A Comprehensive Platform for Matching Users Based on Intellectual Interests and Natural Language Processing *
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Mailing Pigeon is an integrated software platform that connects users with similar intellectual interests and facilitates meaningful conversations. Using natural language processing (NLP) techniques and algorithms such as K-means clustering and Nearest Neighbours the platform analyses user profiles and messages to provide effective matching based on compatibility. Users can engage in discussions, improve their English proficiency, and gain insights into their writing patterns. Mailing Pigeon categorizes users' texting personalities and recommends matches using machine learning models and algorithms. By utilizing text similarity-based approaches like Cosine users can join communities and have conversations with like-minded individuals. The platform also allows users to analyze their profiles, including writing patterns and vocabulary, using algorithms like K-means, Nearest Neighbours, and the NLTK library. Mailing Pigeon aims to enhance social experiences and well-being by addressing the challenges of finding motivated communities in a vast online network. It provides a comprehensive solution for connecting individuals, fostering meaningful conversations, and promoting personal growth in language and communication skills.

articleTitle: Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition with Voice Conversion for Deaf and Dumb
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Individuals primarily communicate with one another through various means, such as verbal language, written language, or nonverbal cues. However, for those who are deaf and dumb, the only mode of communication is sign language. Unfortunately, communication becomes difficult if such people are unaware of sign language, leading to frustration and a lack of ability to express emotions effectively. In emergency situations, the inability to communicate effectively can be particularly challenging. Researchers have looked exploring ways to translate hand motions into text and sounds in order to find a solution around this problem. Both vision-based and non-vision-based methods are frequently employed to identify hand motions or gestures. The former uses sensors, while the latter uses cameras for gesture detection. This study focuses on a vision-based approach and develops a gesture recognition system using artificial neural networks. The system locates and recognizes hand movements, allowing for communication to be maintained with others. The benefits and drawbacks of hand movement recognition are also examined. Overall, this research aims to address the communication barriers faced by those who rely on sign language and to improve their ability to communicate effectively in emergency situations.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding Using Blockchain for Startup Ventures
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nowadays, crowdfunding has become a popular source for raising funds, especially for startups or projects. Many startups opt for crowdfunding platforms to raise funds by exchanging equity because it is affordable and straightforward. However, concerns related to security, investor abuse, and illegal transactions have emerged, which have led to an investigation of the implications of blockchain technology in crowdfunding. In our proposed system, we integrate the functioning of crowdfunding platforms with the blockchain technology. The system will provide a platform for startup ventures where they can pitch their ideas to potential investors. The investors can invest in the ventures in return of equity. All the process is handled by the smart contracts making it transparent, immutable and secure. This reduces the risk of fraudulent transactions. The main advantage of the system is it uses platform sensitive token that can be exchanged with INR and further converted to ER20 token that can be used to communicate with ethereum blockchain. This eliminates the need of having ethers or any kind of wallet for the investors. We have created a mobile based application using Flutter Framework and deployed the smart contract using truffle. We have created a backend using NodeJs server which utilizes the functions from smart contract by creating the instance for them. We have also used MongoDB cloud atlas as a database along with the Ethereum Blockchain.

articleTitle: Diverse Filters from a Single Topology Employing Current Mode Computing Blocks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper is related to an important area of electronics and communication engineering research that deals with the processing of analog signals. The paper proposes new filters of diverse characteristics. The building blocks used for designing the circuits are based on current mode approach. Simple current mode computing blocks are employed for the purpose. The proposed topology can realize filters with different frequency responses. Thus low-pass, high-pass, all-pass, shelving and band-reject filters are realized. The realized filters can also provide differing phase responses by simple specialization of passive elements. The actual SPICE based results using CMOS technology with ±2.5 V supply voltage are included in support of the new proposed topology. The circuits are expected to be useful for wide ranging applications from low, medium to high frequency domains.

articleTitle: Kidney Localization and Stone Segmentation from a CT Scan Image
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Kidney stones are a widespread health problem that can cause severe pain and require urgent medical attention. Accurately identifying and distinguishing kidney stones from other structures in medical images can be challenging due to their varying size, shape, and location. To assist healthcare professionals in making a diagnosis, computer-aided diagnosis systems can be useful, but precise segmentation of the region of interest is crucial. Although CT imaging is a commonly used diagnostic tool for kidney stones, it can be difficult to differentiate stones from other structures, leading to false positives. This study proposes a method to minimize false positives and extract essential structural information for the accurate diagnosis of kidney stones using image processing techniques for kidney organ segmentation with a mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 76.79%. Additionally, the study aims to leverage machine learning algorithm, Linear Regression, to classify CT scans with multiple stones and improved the accuracy and reliability of disease diagnosis by 93.93%.

articleTitle: Weapon Detection from Surveillance Footage in Real-Time Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Weapon violence is a serious threat nowadays due to the rise in technology and criminal intelligence. Manual surveillance is a very tedious task because these activities are atypical in comparison with everyday activities. By introducing machine learning techniques to detect such activities, we can minimise the risk of human errors and prevent details from going unnoticed. Current systems fail when it comes to efficiency of the system and ease of use. We have implemented various models like CNN, YOLOV7, YOLOV8 and VGG for weapon detection and identified their strengths and limitations. A complete system for detection of weapons using these models and raising an alarm has been implemented here to overcome the problems of manual surveillance. Results are presented in a table focusing on metrics like precision and recall as these metrics prove to be more insightful and reliable as compared to accuracy for object detection.

articleTitle: A Clinical Diagnosis Based Approach for EEG-Based Classification of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Hilbert Transform and Single Label SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The goal of this study was to create a machine learning-based technique for identifying electroencephalography (EEG) data to help in the diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The study made use of an EEG dataset containing signals from people with ASD and generally developing people. The classification was done by separating the bands in the EEG signal and extracting features from it. This is like Clinical diagnosis techniques employed by doctors. These were subsequently used as input for the machine learning algorithms. The findings demonstrated that the suggested method could categorise EEG signals with excellent accuracy, sensitivity and specificity showing the potential to be employed as an effective tool for ASD diagnosis.

articleTitle: Pothole Grievance Reporting System Using YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Social media and mobile technology are taking the role of conventional methods for communicating with the government, reporting problems, and offering opinion. To obtain the services they want in a more streamlined and convenient manner, people can use mobile services like SMS and apps. By including citizens in decision-making, problem-solving, and service co-design, these e-participation technologies also encourage more citizen involvement. A web-based application called the Pothole Grievance Reporting System will be used. Through this application, residents will be able utilize our online tool to report concerns about ongoing issues in their ward. Municipal authorities can use this program to track issues and problems that common people are having so they can address them as quickly as feasible. This system offers a simple interface for making a complaint, allowing individuals to express their concerns and track their progress.

articleTitle: Computer Controlled Letter Writing Robotic Arm Using Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this research paper, we propose a robotic arm for writing using speech recognition, which uses a stepper motor and a NodeMCU. The robotic arm is capable of being controlled through voice commands, allowing it to write texts and draw images on paper. The stepper motor controls the arm's movements, while the NodeMCU acts as the microcontroller, responsible for interpreting voice commands and controlling the motor. The voice is recorded using an Android application, and then it is converted to text using a speech recognition Natural Language Processing Model. Through a Firebase database, this translated text is forwarded to Nodemcu. We have tested the accuracy and precision of the system, and the results are promising.

articleTitle: UniDAO: University Decentralised Autonomous Organization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper investigates the potential of decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) in transforming traditional governance systems in higher education institutions. Utilizing a case study, it explores the implementation of a university DAO on the Web3 platform, which leverages blockchain technology, smart contracts, non-fungible tokens (NFTs), and a user interface to facilitate transparent, secure, and efficient democratic governance. The proposed system empowers students, faculty, and staff to engage in decision-making processes, fostering a more inclusive university community. Despite its potential, the system faces limitations such as reliance on an isolated development environment, legal concerns, and scalability challenges. This paper highlights the opportunities and challenges in adopting blockchain-based DAO technology in higher education. It provides insights into its impact on university culture, stakeholder satisfaction, and overall educational quality.

articleTitle: PlanIT: An Itinerary Planner using K-Means Clustering and Travelling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Travelling can be a stressful experience despite being a significant aspect of one's life. It involves various tasks, such as choosing destinations, scheduling trips, and booking accommodation and transportation, which can be tedious. Several factors like travel goals, budget, time constraints, group size, and personal preferences contribute to the challenge of creating a travel itinerary. A database consisting of various tourist destinations is created, then based on the user's preferences, clusters are created from the database to create an itinerary using it. Then using K-Means clustering and Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) a route plan will be created, providing the user with the itinerary in its final form where it shows the details of which tourist destination to visit at what time based on the preferences set by the user.

articleTitle: An Integrated Face Recognition based Attendance Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Everything in the world today is mechanised and connected online. Where everything can be done by machine automatically. Such as it is difficult to deal with the presence of several students in a classroom under the conventional approach. As it is time consuming and there are chances of human errors taking attendance. Marking attendance is a day-to-day activity which is a real-world problem which can be solved using Face recognition. It is also efficient handling bulk of student's attendance than old traditional methods. Attendance systems come in a variety of forms, such as biometric, facial recognition, radio frequency card, and conventional paper-based ones. A facial identification-based attendance system is the safest and most efficient of them all. This paper presents an integrated system which automatically detects face and marks the attendance in the sheet. While building this system, we basically focused on two Machine Learning algorithms that are Haar Cascade and Local Binary pattern Histogram Algorithm (LBPH) also we used Python and OpenCV libraries which is used to make the model more efficient.

articleTitle: Hybrid Density- Grid Based Clustering Algorithms: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: One of the foundational data mining operations called ‘Clustering’ finds similar objects in a given dataset. The paper explores the study of density-based and grid-based clustering algorithms, as well as a combination of both, to identify groups of similar objects that are dissimilar from other objects in different sets of clusters. We performed in detail study of different algorithms in above mentioned categories. Furthermore, the systematic exploration and survey of grid-based clustering algorithms help in comprehending their diverse benefits. This article provides a foundation for identifying the distinctive features, strengths, and potential applications of density-based and grid-based clustering algorithms, thereby facilitating the development of a novel clustering algorithm through their integration. Additionally, we observed the advantages and disadvantages of these algorithms to understand their evolution and applications. This survey allowed us to contemplate the limitations of density-based clustering algorithms. Moreover, conducting a survey of grid-based clustering algorithms helps us understand their various benefits. These approaches can be combined in order to develop a novel clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Denoising of Aged Album and Mural Photographs Using GAN Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This particular study introduces a GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) based methodology to denoise historic photographs. Different forms of Speckle., some form of Gaussian impurity., Salt and Pepper noise., frequently damages the historical photographic clarity. These kinds of noise might make it harder to see crucial aspects of an image and impede additional image processing. We provide a denoising approach based on a GAN to solve this problem. These types of GAN's are used to generate denoised image from a noisy input after being trained to learn the underlying clean image distribution. The testing findings show that the suggested strategy may successfully eliminate various types of noise from old photographs and murals and enhance the quality visually. The outputs demonstrate that the suggested methodology outperforms the other denoising techniques based on the visual quality and denoising efficacy. We have used a total of 550 samples on both the GAN models. For Pix2Pix GAN., we managed to achieve PSNR of 31.295., MSE of 0.571 and SSIM of 0.613 at 500 epochs. GFP GAN., a pre-trained model., was able to obtain PSNR of 33.580., MSE of 0.057 and SSIM of 0.892. This work offers a viable method for denoising old photos and could make an impact on many different image processing applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Misinformation Detection: An Exhaustive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Social media and the web have become the source of misinformation dissemination today. The users generate a variety of misinformation in different categories and forms. The researchers have taken an interest in detecting and classifying false information, mainly in textual data, while multi-modal misinformation detection has started gaining attraction recently. Although some survey papers discuss false information detection techniques, the authors didn't find a survey paper focusing only on multi-modal misinformation detection. Therefore, in this study, authors have reviewed the literature related to multi-modal misinformation detection from 2010 to 2023 to identify the techniques utilized by the researchers, understand the available datasets, and identify the research gaps in this area. This will assist the researchers in understanding the methods used to detect multi-modal misinformation, work on gaps identified and contribute mainly to this area.

articleTitle: Mathematical Validation of 100nm n-MOSFET using Silvaco TCAD
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper attempts to prove the mathematical validation of 100nm n-channel Metal Oxide Semiconductor-FET (MOSFET), with their characteristics and extraction of parameters, i.e. Characterization, the theoretical and practical analysis using Silvaco-TCAD. While performing mathematical validation, a comprehensive study was made, which covers the functioning and mechanism of MOS Devices. articleTitle: Smart Sensor Network for Environment Parameter Monitoring using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study presents an Internet of Things (IoT) based approach to monitor sound level and air quality at various locations. The proposed system employs a NodeMCU with an integrated Wi-Fi module and requisite sensors to track the sound level and air quality index (AQI) at specific sites. The system is capable of measuring variables such as humidity and temperature, in addition to the AQI and sound level, at the site. LM393 sound sensor is utilized for sound detection, DHT-11 sensor module for temperature and humidity monitoring, and MQ-135 gas sensor for air quality measurement. ThingSpeak's cloud platform and cloud technology are employed to store the collected data. The user is promptly notified via SMS when the air quality and sound level exceed a predetermined threshold. Furthermore, the end user is kept informed of environmental factors such as temperature and humidity to enable appropriate action.

articleTitle: Categorical Boosting Machine for Tamil Character Recognition Using Shape Based Features
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Tamil is one of the world's earliest surviving languages, from which modern Indian scripts draw inspiration. However, there has been limited development of Optical Character Recognition techniques for Tamil characters. This paper describes a model for Tamil vowels-based Optical Character Recognition. The strategy seeks to utilise a CHFR feature extraction technique to extract three distinct feature vectors from the contours of each individual character's centroid. These feature vectors are condensed into a single vector before being sent to the CatBoost classifier for classification. Using the Optuna framework, hyperparameter optimisation and comparative analysis of existing models are performed. The proposed scheme is applied to a dataset of 6,972 handwritten samples evenly divided into 12 classes representing the vowels of the Tamil alphabet. The primary evaluation metric is accuracy, and 84.36% testing accuracy is observed.

articleTitle: Advanced Network Traffic Analyzer for Military Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Many security-related network management activities depend on the categorization of network traffic. A net- work administrator can enable or ban specific programs using application specific network traffic (whitelisting/blacklisting) or find harmful apps on the network using this method. In order to determine who owns the traffic at runtime, the network administrators need a network signature for each application on the network. Authentication and authorization are provided by classifying network traffic in this way. Annotated network traffic is often used to create network signatures, which are either manually created or analyzed by the software. In this paper, we have proposed an idea for network traffic analyzer which can be used in military or defense-based applications. We have used Wireshark simulation tool to monitor the network traffic and detect the anomalies present in the network.

articleTitle: Solar Based Multi-Tasking Agri-Robo
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Agriculture is a crucial sector in India, with around 70% of the population depending on it for their livelihood. However, the traditional methods of seed sowing, grass cutting, and pesticide spraying are labour-intensive and require expensive and cumbersome equipment. To address these challenges, there is a need to encourage the development of a system that can reduce labor and save time in the agricultural process. This work aims to design and develop a solar-powered robot capable of sowing seeds, cutting grass, and spraying pesticides. The robot will be operated using an Android app that sends signals for the required mechanisms and movements. By utilizing solar energy, this innovative approach will increase the efficiency of seed sowing, pesticide spraying, and cutting while reducing the problems associated with manual planting. Therefore, the development of such systems is crucial for the growth and sustain ability of the agricultural sector in India.

articleTitle: EzLang: A C Based Programming Language
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Programming languages are constantly evolving to simplify real-world problems and provide unique features. However, this often leads to the need for developers to learn and use different languages for different tasks, resulting in a steep learning curve. This paper introduces EzLang, a new programming language specifically developed to make data visualization easy and accessible. EzLang offers several features to facilitate data visualization tasks. It supports dynamic typing, allowing flexible handling of data, and includes common programming constructs such as loops, conditionals, and functions. Moreover, EzLang provides a rich library of in-built functions tailored for various data visualization purposes, simplifying the development process. To evaluate EzLang's performance, it was compared against existing interpreted languages. The results showcased favorable outcomes for EzLang in terms of execution speed and memory usage. In fact, when tested with small and medium-sized programs, EzLang's performance was comparable to other languages. The research highlights insights into the design and implementation of an interpreted language are presented, along with areas identified for future improvements. Overall, EzLang emerges as a promising programming language designed to streamline data visualization tasks, offering simplicity, efficiency, and a range of built-in functions. Its performance evaluation and exploration of design elements provide a foundation for further enhancements and advancements in the field of data visualization languages.

articleTitle: Improving Image Quality of Noisy Images Through Denoising and Style GAN Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research proposes an approach to enhance the denoising and upscaling performance of noisy images using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), particularly Style GAN architecture. Denoising and upscaling noisy images are crucial in many computer vision applications, and GANs have shown remarkable effectiveness in creating high-quality images. However, training Style GAN requires huge amount of data and is computationally expensive. To address this issue, this study proposes using various filters such as mean, median, and weighted median to pre-process the noisy images before feeding them to Style GAN. The proposed approach achieves superior denoising and up scaling compared with other system in terms of FID and inception score, and further exploration of hyperparameters and variations of the Style GAN architecture can lead to even better results.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition with CNN-SVM for Emotional State Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is useful for many things, including human-computer interaction and emotion analysis. For the purpose of recognizing different facial expressions, we present a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier in this research. Using a large-scale dataset, experiments confirm that the proposed system is effective at using the CNN-SVM model for recognizing seven distinct facial emotions (neutral, angry, surprise, fear, sorrow, disgust, and happy). The experimental findings were very reliable, with high F1 scores and excellent precision across a variety of memory and precision metrics. All classes of facial expressions are accurately interpreted by the algorithm, although the ‘Angry,’ ‘Fear,’ and ‘Happy’ classes do very well. The CNN-SVM model demonstrated its viability in real-world settings by achieving an overall accuracy of 98.06%. With an F1 score of over 97.80 percent, it's clear that the system can recognize a broad variety of emotions. Emotion identification in HCI, sentiment analysis, and content recommendation systems are just few of the areas where these findings highlight the value of the CNN-SVM paradigm.

articleTitle: VATTEN: A Smart Water Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In most parts of the country, water is supplied through individual state governments though different modes. Of which pipelines have been used over decades. Here the bill amount charged will be based on the amount of water consumed and follows a specific mode of calculations. Also there are frequent outbreaks of unwanted water or sewage into water pipelines. Even water supplied may contain harmful substances present.Thus with the help of accurate quality and quantity modules, we can resolve these major issues. Usually, water quality is analyzed through sampling which costs more, involves tedious work and time consuming process which could not be carried out for day to day usage. But VATTEN helps the customers to monitor their water instantaneously and provide better results in a given period of time.There is no need for middlemen to note and update the water consumption readings.If the incoming water is contaminated, then promptly the information regarding quality of the water is reported to the corresponding authority of the customer surroundings. Automatically a valve arrests the flow of water.Further the water gets treated from the Purifier which makes it fit for use. After which it could be used by the people. VATTEN could be installed in all environments in apartments, individual houses, industries, etc. based on the requirements.Awareness among people about the bill calculation i.e. tax amount spent for their day - to - day water usage.

articleTitle: Creation and Implementation of Scenario Database for ADAS Application Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The growth in technology paved the way for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to be implemented in vehicles, resulting in a safer, smoother, and more automated driving experience. ADAS incorporates a variety of features which need to be verified and validated before deployment. This is done by testing the working of the features under different scenarios that a driver may face on road. In order to ensure that all possible scenarios are covered for testing, a scenario database is proposed in this paper. The database proposed would consist of all relevant scenarios needed to validate a particular feature in a vehicle. This is made certain by including a parameterisation concept in the scenario creation process. A definite methodology for creating these scenarios is also put forward in this paper. Traffic jam assist (TJA), curve speed warning (CSW), lane keeping system (LKS) and blind spot detection (BSD) features in ADAS are taken as an example to illustrate the proposed scenario creation process. Intelligent speed assistance (ISA), one of the many features in an ADAS system, is taken as an example to showcase the closed-loop validation of an algorithm in a simulation environment.

articleTitle: Classifying Architectural Images of Digital Heritage: A CNN-SVM Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: India is a nation blessed with a plethora of cultural landmarks, including 37 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, many of which are world-famous architectural structures. We must protect cultural heritages because they bind successive generations together throughout time. Researchers, travelers, architects, etc. They visit several historical locations, where it is frequently challenging for them to recognize and learn more about the historical significance of the building they are fascinated by. Due to the scope and accuracy of the information, it is difficult to archive, preserve, and share knowledge about these cultural treasures. It is easier to examine and comprehend heritage assets when images are accurately predicted to correspond to their right name (heritage site). It takes an enormous amount of time and work to classify data that includes images. In this study, the authors have designed a new hybrid model used to extract the features from architectural images and further classified into different shapes of the architectural sites and achieved 95% accuracy and the highest precision rate is achieved for the Altar class i.e. 88.05%, the highest recall rate is achieved for the Vault class i.e. 87.36<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the highest Fl score rate is achieved for Flying buttress i.e. 89.10%.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hardware and Software Utilization in the Implementation of Full Adder Using Vivado
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: It's an issue for certain developing nations to get enough electricity. By researching and developing a powerful Full adder on the Vivado platform across multiple generations of FPGAs, we have made significant progress towards realising the goal of eco-friendly communication. A wide variety of FPGA families were studied to accomplish this. Several other FPGA families, including Genesys, Kintex, and Zed, are implemented using the Seven series boards. The goal of this study was to determine which FPGA family had the most efficient power usage overall. Each of Genesys, Kintex, and Zed consumes a different amount of energy: 1.08 W, 1.515 W, and 1.025 W, respectively. The temperature in Genesys is 53 degrees Celsius, in Kintex it's 71.1, and in Virtex it's 70.2. Power dissipation can be minimised by switching to the Genesys family of 7 series of components from the other two families, as explained in the manual. Among FPGA families, Zed's power efficiency is on par with the rest. When compared to competing boards, Zed Boards offer significant energy savings.

articleTitle: Analysis of Knowledge Graph Embedding Using Graph Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Knowledge graphs (KG) represent information in the form of graphs. Because heterogeneous and collaborative designs remain incomplete employing missing links between the entity pairs. KG embedding paradigm tries to reduce incompleteness by representing graphs in vector space. Attention-based learning provides the natural way of KG representation learning by deriving attention to each central entity from its neighbors. The attention mechanism decides which part to attend more to collect the most important information. This paper analyzes the attention-based models used to learn KG latent structure and is utilized to predict the missing link for KG completion. Many of them are neural network-based methods. Experimental results show that DisenKGAT and HOLE outperform rest methods in standard evaluation metrics on the two benchmark FB15k-237 and WN18RR datasets respectively.

articleTitle: Cancer Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Due to their environment and way of life, people today experience a broad variety of diseases. So, it is critical to identify issues at an early stage. Though it is very difficult for a doctor to make an exact diagnosis based only on symptoms. Accurate diagnosis of a problem is the most difficult task to complete. The key to resolving this problem is to foresee the illness using data mining. The amount of data in the medical sciences is expanding quickly every year. Early patient treatment has profited from the proliferation of data in the healthcare and medical industries, which has boosted the accuracy of medical data analysis. Data mining reveals hidden patterns in the vast volume of medical data by using medical data. The detection and diagnosis of cancer are becoming increasingly automated. The prognosis for cancer will be quite straightforward in the future, so we won't even need to go to the hospital. As we can see, a range of technologies are being used and tested by the medical business. This says that cancer diagnosis will probably become less difficult in the future. The approaches for the detection of cancer using Random Forest, Decision tree, KNN, and Naive Bayes are all being evaluated in this paper. We are working on a machine learning-based cancer prediction model that takes into consideration various cancer kinds. Several features are offered by cancer prediction algorithms that ask for user input before delivering findings.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Using machine learning techniques like Logistic Regression, The Support Vector Machine i.e. (SVM) classifiers, The Random Forest classifiers i.e. (RFC), The Decision Tree classifiers i.e. (DTC), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), as well as basic metrics like heart rate, blood pressure, cholesterol, and pulse rate, the goal of this project is to forecast the occurrence of various diseases like diabetes, heart disease, and Parkinson's disease. The most accurate calculation is used to train the dataset, while Python pickling and streamlit are used to record the model behavior. By entering pertinent disease-related information, the initiative seeks to determine the risk factors for the diseases and provide users a prognosis of whether they have the condition or not. This program can assist people in keeping an eye on their health and taking the necessary actions to prolong

articleTitle: Design of Integrated PLC with SCADA Systems for Grooving Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This work mainly focused on the grooving machine using PLC with SCADA, PLC, and SCADA are used as the control device to fulfill the working of this machine. The programming language used in PLC and SCADA systems is often simple and easy to understand, allowing for efficient and effective control of the grooving machine. The programming for the grooving machine using PLC and SCADA involves defining the inputs and outputs, setting up the control logic, and specifying the operating parameters. The requirement of the grooved surface and grooved connecting rod is to improve the precision and quality of the final product. With PLC and SCADA, the accuracy of the grooving machine is achieved. The drives used in this machine are responsible to move the servo motors for the desired movement of the axis. There are four axes in this machine namely X1, X2, Y, and Z. The laser source used here is operated on 24 Vdc with 100-Watt power. The overall system is created to improve production with a high precision rate.

articleTitle: Sentence Meaning Similarity Detector Using FAISS
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sentence meaning similarity in machine learning (ML), which is automatically done by calculating the semantic similarity between sentences. In this study, word embeddings are used to depict sentences as numerical vectors in a high-dimensional space. It is then discussed how different similarity measures may be applied to evaluate these vectors and determine how similar the sentences are. The FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) method is covered in the study. An open-source library developed by Facebook AI Research for similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, can be used to efficiently calculate sentence similarity by leveraging its efficient nearest neighbor search capabilities. Searching exhaustively increases the number of comparisons to decrease that we proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Optimization: The Role of Solar Tracking Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The ecosystem is being harmed using fossil fuels, so renewable energy sources are required to protect the climate for coming generations. The most popular green energy source is solar power, but its effectiveness is impacted by the sun's varying positions. This paper suggests a practical method-a single-axis solar tracking system-for increasing the electricity output of solar panels. Compared to a stationary system, the suggested system can boost a panel's power production according to tests conducted in a variety of weather conditions and positioning. The device uses very little energy and is a practical way to increase the efficiency of solar panels. Thus, putting this method into place can aid in maximizing solar energy and lowering reliance on fossil fuels.

articleTitle: Reinforced Grey Wolf Optimization Based Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithm for Photovoltaic Systems Under Varying Irradiation Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Maximum Power Point Tracking is a method used in photovoltaic systems to optimize the power output of solar panels by monitoring the point of maximum power. Traditional MPPT techniques like P&O and IC can analyze the MPP in a uniform shading environment, but they fall short when there is partial shading. This is due to their drawbacks such as frequent oscillations, getting stuck at local maxima, etc. Therefore, it is challenging to use these algorithms in a PV system to produce optimal and dependable power. This project makes use of a meta-heuristic algorithm named grey wolf optimization (GWO) for a photo voltaic system for MPPT. The GWO is a new optimization methodology to overcome these problems with different algorithm strategies, like decreased tracking efficiency and transients. To overcome the issues, a new algorithm called Reinforced GWO has been extracted by altering the original GWO's hunting equation and encircling equation. The proposed system is being studied for a PV array operating under PSCs that shows minimum fluctuations in power and output power stability around the MPP. The simulation and associated results demonstrate that the suggested MPPT algorithm performs better than Standard GWO in terms of superior stability and fewer output power fluctuations as well as overall effective efficiency. The proposed Reinforced GWO MPPT algorithm is implemented on PV systems using MATLAB SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Virtual Mouse and Gesture Based Keyboard
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nowadays, computer science has evolved to the point where a computer can authenticate its owner using a basic picture-processing algorithm. People are currently adopting this vision in many parts of daily life, such as facial recognition, colour detection, autonomous autos, and so on. This concept uses hand and face motions to make an optical mouse and a hand-gesture-based virtual keyboard using computer vision. The computer's camera will scan a view of the different movements made by a person's face and eye. Based on the movement of the motions, the computer's mouse or pointer will move, even completing right and left clicks using different gestures. Similarly, several gestures may be used to access keyboard operations. For example, selecting letters can be done with one finger, and left and right swiping can be done with a four-figure motion. It will function as a virtual mouse and keyboard without the use of any connectors or other hardware. The camera is the only piece of hardware utilized in the project, and Python is used for the coding on the Anaconda platform. The computer will recognize user movements and respond correctly after mapping a few of them with the mouse and keyboard.

articleTitle: Analysis of Negative Sampling Methods for Knowledge Graph Embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Negative sampling is an approach used to speed up knowledge graph embedding learning and maximize the efficacy of embedding models for supported tasks such as link prediction and entity resolution. Negative sampling is essentially important to improve accuracy, reducing bias, increasing efficiency, and improving representation. This paper scrutinizes the aftermath of increasing the number of negative samples per positive available for two basic negative sampling techniques for tensor factorization and translational embedding models on the benchmark dataset Fb15k. For both uniform and Bernoulli sampling, pattern showing changes in performance based on increasing numbers of negatives per positive is worth noticing.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement by Optimal Placement of D-STATCOM for Power System Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research paper presents a detailed study on the optimal placement of a Distribution Static Compensator (D-STATCOM) in a 14-bus power system. The objective of the study is to identify the optimal location for the D-STATCOM that can compensate the reactive power in the system. The paper proposes a methodology that utilizes load flow analysis and deduction of maximum voltage and current harmonics to identify the optimal location of the D-STATCOM. Newton Raphson method is used for load flow analysis. The load flow analysis is used to determine the voltage and power flow conditions in the system. D-STATCOM control is achieved by direct quadrature zero method. The proposed methodology is validated through extensive simulations on the 14-bus power system. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed methodology can identify the optimal location for the D-STATCOM that compensates the reactive power in the system. The study provides valuable insights into the optimal placement of D-STATCOM in power systems, which can help power system operators and planners in enhancing the overall system performance and reliability.

articleTitle: Object Detection, Tracking, and Prediction Analysis System for Sports Performance and Coaching
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Object detection and tracking systems have diverse real-world applications, including surveillance and security, autonomous vehicles, robotics, sports analysis, and medical imaging. These systems can detect and track objects of interest, providing valuable insights into various domains and enabling autonomous operation. Current object analysis systems often have limitations in accuracy and, efficiency, and realtime processing capabilities. These limitations include occlusion, motion blur, lighting conditions, scale and orientation, computational complexity, false positives and false negatives, and limited object types. These limitations can affect the applicability of object analysis systems in various domains and limit their ability to detect and track objects accurately. The proposed system aims to overcome these limitations by leveraging the powerful processing capabilities of Jetson Xavier and combining the Kalman filter and polynomial regression techniques for more accurate and efficient object analysis. The proposed system uses state-of-the-art computer vision techniques for object tracking and trajectory prediction. The proposed approach can be valuable in sports analysis, providing accurate and efficient object detection, tracking, and prediction analysis.

articleTitle: Realization of Positive Feedback Source Coupled Logic Even Parity Generator/Checker
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this paper, the realization of a even parity generator/checker (3-bit) in positive feedback source coupled logic style (PFSCL) is proposed. Three different realizations for even parity generator/checker (3-bit) are proposed. The first realization is based on employing conventional PFSCL-based NOR/OR gate, second realization use PFSCL fundamental cell (FC), and third realization is based on involving memristor in PFSCL style. The proposed implementations are simulated and validated using LT SPICE simulations with PTM 90nm CMOS technology parameters. A comparative analysis is carried out to evaluate the performance based on gate count, transistor count, average delay, power consumption, power delay product (PDP), and area. It is observed that proposed realization-3 outperforms over the other proposed realizations. The proposed realization -3 involving the use of memristors in PFSCL 3-bit even parity generator realization achieves a maximum reduction of 48%, 87.5%, 93%, 95.66% in average delay, power, PDP and area values respectively in comparison to other realizations that are based on existing architecture. The simulation results for the checker follows the similar trend. The impact of technology scaling is also studied for all the proposed realizations.

articleTitle: Insights into Automated Diagnosis of Cervical Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The cervix is the last part of the uterus where cervical cancer usually develops. Identification of the cervical cells can be very taxing owing to their complexity of morphological changes in the structural parts of the cell. The problem here is that the detection process is tardy and there is not much awareness about it. By means of this research, we have taken a step to attempt to automate this detection process and understood the various methods used like Logistic regression along with Ll Regularization, CNN, SVM and ANN produced excellent accuracy of 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hand Gesture Recognition with Media Pipe and SVM Model on Custom Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Gesture recognition is an important area of research with many potential applications such as human-computer interaction, language recognition, and gaming. In this research paper a new approach to motion recognition using the Media Pipe and SVM models has been explained. The approach includes preprocessing the video motion input, using Media Pipe to extract relevant features, and using an SVM model to classify the annotation and to evaluate the proposed methods in public information and demonstrate the effectiveness of the plan by achieving high accuracy.

articleTitle: Secure Path Key Establishment for WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Several path key setup strategies make the assumption that node capture attacks are equally likely to affect every node in a wireless sensor network. However, in crucial applications like border surveillance and crisis management, this supposition might not hold true, making such schemes unworkable. In order to lower the issue of key exposure, this article suggests an attack matrix (AM) that determines the attack coefficient of sensor nodes based on where they are located in the sensor field. The disjoint path key establishment is an attack-resilient path key establishment method that is developed using the AM. The suggested scheme outperforms the current path key establishment technique in terms of performance, and the likelihood of key recovery and the path compromise ratio are used to confirm that they are resistant to node capture. The outcomes show how well the suggested strategies work to lessen the effects of node capture.

articleTitle: “Ensemble Incremental Model” for Misinformation Detection in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: With the growth of social media usage, information sharing has become a concern due to the spread of misinformation and its strong impact on society. Researchers have developed innovative techniques to detect and classify false information online. Improving the accuracy of these models using ensemble learning methods has gained popularity recently. However, these ensemble models are based on standard machine learning and ensemble classifiers and don't consider the novel classifiers related to false information detection. In addition, the ensemble models developed so far consider only textual features, leading to over fitting the models. Further, the changing data is a concern as the models show poor performance with old data. Considering these limitations, authors have proposed the 'Ensemble Incremental Model (ElM),’ which extracts novel user and textual features, implements the ensemble method using recently developed Content Similarity Measure (CSM) algorithm and standard machine learning classifiers, and incorporates incremental learning approach. It was observed that the novel approach EIM showed the highest accuracy of 93.44%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Accurate and Efficient Pomegranate Fruit Disease Detection: A Novel Approach to Improve Crop Yield and Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents a web-based tool for identifying diseases in fruit crops to address the negative impact of climate change on agriculture. With the increase in population, there is a growing demand for more food production, which puts pressure on farmers to increase crop yields. However, climate change is causing uneven weather conditions, leading to decreased crop yields. This paper proposes a solution that allows farmers to upload an image of a fruit to a system that has a trained dataset of fruit images. The system uses several image processing steps, including feature extraction based on parameters such as color, morphology, and CCV, followed by clustering using CNN Algorithm and classification using SVM to determine if the fruit is infected or not. An intent search technique is used to find the user intention from the features extracted. The experimental evaluation of the approach shows that it is effective, with a 98.38% accuracy rate in identifying diseases in fruit crops. The proposed tool can be used to identify the diseases that affect fruit crops and provide farmers with timely and accurate information, enabling them to take preventive measures to protect their crops, improve crop yields, and contribute to the overall agricultural economy. The recommendations for the application of the developed machine learning model for pomegranate fruit disease detection include using high-quality data, regularly updating the model, integrating with other detection methods, providing an easy-to-use interface, and providing technical support to growers.

articleTitle: Farmer Circle:An Online Auction Website for Selling Crops Directly to Businesses
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Farmers have to face many difficulties, including the fact that they are getting paid much less than what work they do. Middle-men take advantage of the poor farmers living in villages by buying produce from them in very less price. Helping farmers by getting them a better price for their products and at the same time, helping wholesalers and other small businessmen to get fresh produce for even lower price is the main aim of our project. We have created a comprehensive website which allows a farmer and a wholesaler who buys the produce on the website. This website aims to increase the farmers' financial power by providing a bidding integrated e-commerce platform to increase their income. The farmer can start a 'bidding process' of the produce and wholesalers can bid on the produce for different prices. The farmer can then sell the produce to the highest bidder, thus getting most profit. Similarly, the bidder can choose what all goods he wants to buy, and get a fresh produce at a much less price.

articleTitle: Zero-Day Attack Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cybercrime is complicated and ever-changing phenomenon. Malicious hackers are becoming more skilled, and they are attracting consumers as well as public and private institutions. As a response, extra defences are required. Since organizations began to use computers to do business, the complexity and financial consequences of cybercrime have grown. More and more hacks are based on software vulnerabilities, resulting in the disclosure of customer data and the destruction of the company image. One of the most difficult tasks in modern cybersecurity is protecting against zero-day attacks. Despite manufacturers improving their detection of zero-day exploits, the number of zero-day threats and their impact continues to rise. By the day, tools and tactics for building zero-day exploits, circulating them, and carrying out zero-day assaults become increasingly complex, pervasive, and simple to use. On the other hand, identifying and blocking ongoing thefts is becoming increasingly difficult due to the complexity of the systems that cybersecurity professionals are working with, as well as the advanced degree of encryption and complexity utilized by malicious programs. This means that there is an increasing demand for precise zero-day attack prevention and detection technologies.

articleTitle: Bird Call Recognition using Acoustic based Feature Selection approach in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The recognition of bird calls has been a challenging task in the field of bioacoustics. With the advancement of machine learning algorithms, automatic bird call recognition has become an active research area. In this paper, acoustic feature selection is used which involves the extraction of relevant features from audio recordings of bird calls. Then different classification algorithms are explored for the recognition of the bird calls. Evaluation of the approach is done on a dataset consisting of recordings from multiple bird species and compared it with other state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms. This research has the potential to contribute to the conservation of bird species and their habitats by enabling the efficient monitoring of bird populations. The data is classified into four different classes (namely Astfly, Bulori, Warvir and Woothr). All of which is found in the depths of Amazon Rainforest.

articleTitle: Contrastive Learning Based Unsupervised Sentence Embeddings for Hinglish
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Hinglish language is a hybrid mixture of Hindi and English text in Latin script. According to a survey by a company named milestone localization, 58 % of the population of India who are using technology prefer reading and sending social media messages in Hinglish. Sentence embeddings are basically the vector representation of that sentence in numerical form, which computers can understand. There are a lot of applications where embeddings are mandatory. The current state of the art sentence embedding model, SBERT (sentence Bert) is trained on specific English-supervised labeled datasets, STS (semantic textual similarity), and NLI (natural language inference). These datasets are in paired format and require time-consuming and expensive human annotations. So building these models for low-resourced languages like Hindi becomes hard because there aren't enough specialized datasets. The propsed work ia slight modification of unsupervised model simcse (Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings), which was introduced in 2021 by authors Tianyu Gao et al. The work revolves around finetuning an unsupervised embedding model on approximately 10,000 hinglish sentences. We evaluated a couple of transformers based on simcse with a Hiinglish transliterated version of standard STS data. Out of all the transformer distill-bert model performed best with a Sperman's similarity score of 0.60 A comparative analysis of the embedding quality of different transformer models is also discussed.

articleTitle: Controllable Slogan Generation with Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Slogans form an important part of any marketing campaign. Catchy and effective slogans get remembered by the target audience which leads to a long-term word of mouth and reputation, which is crucial for any product. There have been multiple attempts before to generate slogans from product description using language models. But most of these approaches are limited in variance and control. In this paper, we propose an approach that makes use of diffusion to fine-tune a BERT model to generate a slogan in the context of the input text description along with additional control parameters such as sentiment and number of named entities in a plug-and-play manner which provides scalability. We also evaluate the performance of our model with existing approaches to slogan generation and demonstrate the potential of this approach while also providing better control over slogan generated.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Wind Energy System in Distribution System Using GA & WEO: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Distribution systems need special planning to take the advantage of reduce power losses, improvement in voltage profile, and maximization of capacity of feeder. This paper presents, a optimal sizing and location problem of non-dispatchable energy source such as wind energy with the help of the genetic algorithm and water evaporation algorithm in radial distribution system. The comparative analysis between genetic algorithm and water evaporation algorithm is also investigated considering the problem of optimal sizing and location. In this paper, DG planning optimization is based on minimizing energy loss. The system is subject to constraints such as nodal power balance, feeder current limit, and node voltage limit, among others. This comparison analysis is carried out on IEEE-33 bus radial distribution system, and the simulation results are encouraging for optimal DG sizing and location issues.

articleTitle: Automated Smart Home Security System Using Biometric Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Security is a process; it's an ongoing endeavor to keep one step ahead of threats and safeguard what matters most. Security is not a product. Everybody can find shelter in a home, which offers a sense of security and stability. Its security is crucial for defending belongings against potential dangers including break-ins and burglaries, which may increase the risk of theft, burglary, and property damage, resulting in financial and emotional suffering. In this study, we analyze these issues, pinpoint potential remedies, and offer predictions about the development of smart home security. In order to improve the safety and security of houses more effectively than some of the current accessible alternatives, an effective home security system technology is a crucial first step. This investigation assesses the current state of IoT security, identifies the issues encountered, and proposes workable solutions in order to increase the security of IoT systems and devices. A person is found using a PIR motion sensor. The YOLO method is used to identify the images that are captured by the camera module. Depending on the circumstance, electromagnetism is opened using a Raspberry Pi. The user is received the last notification regarding cloud-based door opening.

articleTitle: Enhanced Mobility Assistive And Tracking Device for Elderly and Visually Impaired Individuals
