publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The aging population and visually impaired individuals often face mobility challenges and are at higher risk of accidents and falls. In this research, we propose the design and development of an IoT-based smart tracking stick that can assist elderly and visually impaired people in their daily activities. The need for assistive technologies to support mobility and independence among elderly and visually impaired individuals is becoming more crucial. In this research, we propose the design, development, and evaluation of an IoT-based smart tracking stick that leverages sensor technologies and smartphone connectivity to enhance the safety and quality of life of elderly and visually impaired individuals. The stick can be located by a smartphone via SMS, which provides real-time tracking and location data to caregivers or family members. The proposed smart stick is equipped with various sensors such as GPS - GSM, LDR sensor, Ardiuno Microcontoller, force sensor, water level sensor, ultrasonic sensor and various other sensor's. A force sensor can be utilized by the stick to detect the presence of a impaired individual and also ensure that they are holding it securely.

articleTitle: Data Deduplication Using Python
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper aims to develop a data deduplication technique for optimizing storage utilization in enterprise environments and for general users. Data deduplication is a process that identifies and eliminates duplicate data from storage systems, resulting in reduced requirements and lower costs. The project involves working on duplicate files from the folders present in storage systems and processing them to reduce the redundancy of data. The results of the project will provide valuable insights on usage of data deduplication technique to delete duplicate files. This method can be used by users to optimize their storage utilization and reduce their storage costs. Additionally, the project will contribute to the field of data storage and management by providing a way to reduce the constant storage of duplicate files.

articleTitle: IoT Based Real-Time Human Physiological Parameters Monitoring and Early Detection with Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In modern days, monitoring our near one's health status is getting difficult day by day. There is a need or requirement to track health details. The proposed method mainly focuses on the body parameter's indication & notification monitoring system using IoT. This real-time monitoring system enables the precaution and helps in automation to minimize not only the risk of human errors but also the risk to human life by early detecting, recording, and sending data effectively. In this system, the sensors are connected to a controller to track the status which is displayed on a monitor to be visible for patients and the system will give alerts. If the system detects any abrupt changes/readings in the patient's physiological parameters, the system automatically notifies the doctor/relatives about the patient's status over IoT & also shows details of the same, over the internet in minimum time.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The prediction of predict the long-term value of stocks is somewhat challenging due to the complexity of the task. One of the most common factors that prevent investors from accurately assessing stock prices is the relationship between the market and the company's fundamentals. In this paper, we propose an algorithm that uses machine learning techniques to predict stock prices. The goal of proposed work is to analyze the effectiveness of LSTM models in forecasting stock prices. Data on a particular company's historical stock price is preprocessed and then trained to produce an LSTM model. It is then subjected to a test set to evaluate its accuracy and other aspects. As compare to SVR, RNN and other models, the LSTM model was able to capture the stock price trends and patterns in a way that is more accurate than traditional forecasting techniques. Since the stock market is volatile, making informed decisions can be challenging for investors when relying solely on SVR's predicted prices. The findings of the study suggest that the model can be a useful tool for financial analysts and investors. The preferred method is to employ a computer-based algorithm, as it will only advise you based on facts and figures, and it won't take into account biases or emotions.

articleTitle: NLP Based Question Answering System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The proliferation of data in various domains has increased the significance of Question Answering Systems (QAS), which utilize Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to comprehend and respond to natural language queries. This review paper provides a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in QAS that employ NLP techniques. However, this thesis concentrates on specific QA scenarios where the answer is explicitly present in the text source. The objective is to build a QA system that can extract answers from plain text sources quickly, precisely, and accurately, using only a single sentence or a fragment of a sentence. The paper discusses the obstacles involved in creating QAS and how NLP techniques can overcome them. The paper proposes a question answering system that combines extractive and abstractive summarization methods to produce brief and accurate answers to user questions. The system uses keyword extraction and classification to identify pertinent information from a collection of documents and then combines extractive and abstractive summarization approaches to create a comprehensive and concise response. The research findings indicate that the proposed system has significant potential to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of question answering systems in a range of applications.

articleTitle: IoT Based Continuous Glucose Monitoring: An Insight into Current Trends and Limitations
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In order to remotely access patient data and continuously monitor their blood glucose levels, patients can now use the Internet of Things (loT) and continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) as a potential strategy for managing diabetes. The purpose of this review is to evaluate the effectiveness of CGM with loT as a diabetes management tool and to look into the benefits, limitations, and challenges of using CGM with loT in the treatment of diabetes with an emphasis on recent studies. Studies that evaluated the effectiveness of CGM with loT for controlling diabetes were included in the review. The study found that CGM plus loT is an effective diabetes management tool. Increased time spent in the target glucose range, a reduction in hypoglycemia, and improved glycemic control have all been associated with the use of CGM with loT. Additionally, it has been shown that CGM combined with loT's remote patient data access enhances patient outcomes and lowers healthcare costs. Costs and technological challenges, however, may limit the adoption of CGM with loT. It is also concluded that more research is needed to determine the long-term cost- and efficacy of CGM with loT in controlling diabetes.

articleTitle: Blind Text Reader and Currency DetectorUsing Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The blind text reader with currency detection project on the Raspberry Pi aims to assist individuals with visual impairments. The project utilizes a Raspberry Pi, a camera module, and various software components to capture images of text and banknotes, perform optical character recognition (OCR) to extract text and convert it into speech using a text-to-speech engine. Additionally, the project incorporates image processing techniques and machine learning algorithms to detect and recognize the value of banknotes, providing real-time currency information. This project showcases the potential of technology in enhancing accessibility and independence for visually impaired individuals.

articleTitle: Development and Validation of Autonomous Emergency Braking System for Advanced Driver Assistance Application
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) have become a popular trend in modern vehicles providing essential information for the driver and implementing safer driving decisions. There are various features in the ADAS system that helps in its ADAS functionality. In this paper, a popular ADAS feature called Autonomous emergency braking (AEB) is presented. AEB is one such ADAS feature incorporated in vehicles that applies brake automatically when there is an obstacle detected near in front. The algorithm is developed using Simulink®. The system uses sensor fusion output of radio detection and ranging (RADAR) and a camera sensor for accurately identifying the obstacle in front of the vehicle. Different EURO NCAP based scenarios are created and the control algorithm is validated.

articleTitle: Warehouse Access Control System Using ESP32CAM, Arduino UNO
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This project aims to develop a warehouse security system using an ESP32CAM, keypad, and Arduino UNO, LCD. The ESP32CAM is a powerful microcontroller that integrates Wi-Fi and a camera module, making it an ideal choice for surveillance. The keypad serves as an input device for entering the password to unlock the door, which is connected to the Arduino UNO. The system is designed to be easy to install and use, with a user-friendly interface for setting and changing the password. The keypad is connected to a solenoid lock, which is used to control the lock mechanism of the door. The system employs a secure password storage mechanism, ensuring that the password is kept safe from unauthorized access. Additionally, the ESP32CAM serves as a surveillance camera, allowing users to monitor the warehouse remotely. This project offers a cost-effective and innovative solution for securing warehouses or offices. The system provides a simple and effective way to control access to a room, and the use of the ESP32CAM and keypad enhances the convenience of the system. Users can easily unlock the door by entering a password, eliminating the need for physical keys. Overall, this project showcases the potential of using modern technologies to improve the security and functionality of traditional door lock systems.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Rate of Crimes Committed Against Women Using Machine Learning Approach and Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Prediction of the probability of crime in any region is a serious problem, especially in developing countries. Several factors can influence the crime rate at any location. There have been no effective solutions or dedicated research studies on the increasing crime cases, especially among women. Thus, we have trained several machine learning algorithms and a neural network to come up with the best probability prediction model for different crime types. The data used was gathered from 50 districts in Madhya Pradesh, India. The trained models were evaluated based on their accuracy and f1-score in predicting the probability of different types of crimes.

articleTitle: Optimizing CNN Model Performance for MNIST and CIFAR Classification Using Rectified Sigmoid and ReS Activation Functions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this work, we implemented and evaluated the accuracy of two commonly used activation functions in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) or/and Sigmoid, as well as a newer activation function called Residual (Res) activation function. trained CNN models with each of these activation functions on MNIST and CIFAR datasets and evaluate their performance. Overall, this work provides insights into the performance of different activation functions in CNNs.in CIFAR dataset Res Activation function provides slightly better accuracy than the Leaky ReLU and PReLU activation function and rectify_sigmoid achieving a slightly higher accuracy of 89.82%, compared to the activation function of res.

articleTitle: Phyto Leafy Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Plants serve an essential part in environment by supplying animals with food, O2(oxygen) and shelter. Numerous flora and herb varieties have a lengthy history being utilized as pharmaceuticals and medicinal therapies in conventional medicine. Widely used in folk is still used in many countries (including India) for a number of causes, including the fact that plants and herbs are less expensive than other types of prescription medicines, and plants are harmless and have no adverse effects when used correctly. However, correct identification of therapeutic plant types remains a difficult job in machine learning. Several more electronic systems for greenhouse taxonomic identification have been suggested in recent years, but the majority of these systems only provide acceptable accuracies for a particular and restricted collection of plant species. We create a novel ethnomedicinal identification based on the retrieval of texture and provides multiple color characters from plant leaf pictures in this paper.

articleTitle: CI-CD Workflow For Embedded System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Current hot topics in software development include continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) [3]. As quality and stability are crucial components of embedded systems, several methodologies and tools are utilized to produce embedded software more quickly [4]. Developers receive feedback on their changes immediately after committing code when CI is effectively implemented, and issues are repaired more quickly. However, for many embedded systems, the use of CI is constrained by a lack of hardware and complexity. Using a virtual platform and simulation techniques, it is feasible to run code meant for even deeply embedded target systems on standard PCs and servers. This enables an effective CI solution that is both more versatile and less expensive than just depending on hardware[3]. By taking into account hardware dependencies and interface constraints, certain ways have been proposed, such as: Automating continuous integration to minimize build and test times, Static code analysis to examine the code's structure and find abnormalities that lead to actual bugs, Automated continuous deployment and Automate the deployment process to analyze drastically reduce the time and enable faster feedback [4].

articleTitle: Smart EV Kit (Pressure Sensor and Key Ignition)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper is intended to provide enhanced safety to the electric vehicles (EVs), by using the electric vehicles the common problem detected by users which may cause danger to the vehicle and the user both. Now a day the use of EVs increases day by day. Presented work proposes and implements a solution to few problems with EVs. One of the problem with EVs over the IC engine vehicle is that it has a very low sound, comparably negligible, causes it difficult to detect the starting and stopping of the vehicle, and simultaneously it may cause a major accident if it is not detected the starting of the vehicle by the user, so have to make the working model with the help of the Force sensor and piezoelectric sensors which will detect the human position on the seat of the bike and after enough criterion for weight is satisfied by the user, then only the vehicle will start after a delay of 3–4 seconds with a buzzer indication.

articleTitle: Electricity Billing and Consumption Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research suggests a AI-Learning based method for forecasting electricity usage and bill amounts. The project develops and assesses a number of machine learning models using historical electricity use data and customer billing information. The dataset, which consists of several months' worth of historical data from a residential power client, is used to train and test the models. The study shows that the suggested machine learning models are highly accurate in forecasting electricity consumption and bill amounts. According to the results, machine learning-based methods can greatly increase the precision of predictions of power use and bills, which can be helpful for both consumers and utility providers. The goal of this paper is to create a system that fuses the findings of various machine learning techniques, in order to conduct accurate prediction for a tenant. K nearest neighbour, Support vector machine and Artificial Neural Networks are few of the algorithms that are employed. Each algorithm's accuracy is determined along with the model's accuracy. The model for predicting is then chosen from those with decent accuracy. The dataset used for building the model is Smart metres Database, which was selected from Kaggle website.

articleTitle: Coffee Bean Grading Based on Weight Estimation Using Densenet121 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Coffee bean grading is a crucial process in the coffee industry, traditionally done manually by human experts, which is time-consuming, expensive, and prone to errors. To address these challenges, deep learning models have emerged as a powerful tool for automating coffee bean grading. This study uses the Densenet121 model to analyze a dataset of 363 images of manually graded coffee beans to recognize the different grades based on their features and patterns. The results show that the deep learning model achieves an accuracy of 81.89%, demonstrating its potential for revolutionizing the coffee industry by offering speed, accuracy, cost-effectiveness, scalability, and consistency in quality production. This study highlights the promising potential of deep learning models in image analysis and grading for various industries, with further research and development.

articleTitle: Applications of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Contemporary Quality Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The increasing complexity and global competition in various industries have compelled organizations to prioritize quality engineering as a critical factor for success. In recent years, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have emerged as transformative technologies with the potential to revolutionize quality engineering practices. This paper explores the applications of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in contemporary quality engineering. With the rapid growth of technology and increased demand for quality products, there is a need for efficient and effective methods for quality control. AI and ML provide innovative solutions for improving quality engineering processes' accuracy, speed, and consistency.we discuss the role of AI and ML in data analysis and decision-making processes, enabling quality engineers to identify patterns, anomalies, and correlations within vast datasets. These techniques empower organizations to make data-driven decisions, optimize processes, and detect potential quality issues in realtime. The limitations and difficulties of these technologies are discussed, along with potential future lines of investigation. The research presented in this paper suggests that AI and ML hold great promise for revolutionizing quality engineering and raising standards across the board for goods and services.

articleTitle: Ocular Disease Recognition with Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Retinal pathologies are a major cause of childhood blindness and require rapid detection to reduce the workload of ophthalmologists. Deep learning algorithms are ideal for this field due to their dependence on pattern recognition. Each disease has varying stages of severity and specific lesions with unique morphological features. We present three ensemble models including binary and multi-class classifiers for different ocular diseases and stages of Diabetic Retinopathy. The models are built by studying lesion characteristics, data processing steps, identifying necessary libraries, and experimenting with various methods. Public databases are used for training and validation, and final prediction accuracy is reported.

articleTitle: “Sign Language Talk” Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: People with special needs frequently experience hearing loss, which impacts many parts of their lives and prevents them from interacting socially and communicating with others efficiently. The community of people who are speech-impaired use sign languages as their native tongues and have complete access to communication. Hand gestures are used in sign language to convey the intended meaning of people with specific communication needs to the outside world. This project proposes “Sign Language Talk,” a machine learning-based sign language-to-speech system that will assist people in improving their communication skills. It helps in the conversion of real-time sign language image input to text and speech which allows communication between speech-impaired people and normal people. The speaker output helps to understand this sign language to visually impaired people too. The project is implemented on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using Python tools, which takes input through the camera and compares it with a pre-loaded Indian Sign Language (ISL) dataset and generates text output on the screen as well as speech output through speakers. The parameters such as accuracy, precision, and recall were taken into consideration for evaluating the project. During the training of the model, Accuracy was obtained to be 100%. The Accuracy outcome with the project in runtime was observed to be 87%. The software can also be used for educational purposes in practicing sign language in schools of speech-impaired students.

articleTitle: Memory Utilization of AI Application for DSP and ARM Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This electronic Memory is a crucial component in any AI application, including those running on the OMAPL138 platform. The OMAPL138 is a system-on-chip that integrates a variety of components, including a dual-core ARM Cortex-A8 processor and memory subsystems. In AI applications, memory is used for storing training data, model parameters, and intermediate computations. The amount and type of memory required depend on the complexity of the model and the size of the data set. For example, Computer vision models typically require large amounts of memory to store the weights and biases of the neural network. The OMAPL138 platform includes several types of memory, including on-chip RAM, external SDRAM, and flash memory. The on-chip RAM is used for storing small amounts of data and code that need to be accessed quickly. The external SDRAM provides additional memory for storing larger data sets and intermediate computations. The flash memory is used for storing the application code and data that need to persist across power cycles. The significance of memory in AI applications on the OMAPL138 platform lies in its ability to provide the computational resources required to train and run complex models. Without sufficient memory it would not be possible to store the large amounts of data and parameters required for Computer vision application models, and the performance of the system would be severely limited.

articleTitle: Advancements in Melanoma Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the past few years skin cancer has become the most common cancer worldwide, and come to know that Melanoma is the most prevalent form of cancer. Also, it's difficult to detect Melanoma in its early stage even for a skilled dermatologist. Recently detecting Melanoma has been viable due to Deep Learning. In this study, we surveyed the effectiveness of various deep-learning algorithms for Melanoma skin cancer detection. We have studied various papers and evaluated different methods on the basis of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, preprocessing techniques used, image segmentation, image classification, and feature extraction. The findings of this study will shed important light on how well various deep learning algorithms perform at melanoma skin cancer detection, which may assist direct the creation of more efficient diagnostic tools and enhance patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Identification of Medicinal Plant by Flower, Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In image processing the key to correctly identify the medicinal herbs is crucial. Mislabeling of medicinal plants can have adverse effects. Plants can be recognized by their size, color, and texture of its leaves and flowers, they are also an example of morphological characteristics. Different plant's flowers have diverse shapes, colors, and textures, so it is impossible to categorize and identify them based on just one characteristic. This paper proposes a medicinal plant recognition technique based on images that contain texture and skeletal of the flower and leaf. Experiments are performed on 9 different medicinal plants with a collection of 300 flower images and visuals of leaves for each class. The suggested method is used to recognise floral pictures that contain particular phases. The first approach to improve the flower pictures is pre-processing. then followed by segmentation of the flowers and leaf's skeletal, where as shape and texture are commonly extracted features. Additional features were put on and fed to classifiers like FRCNN(Fast region with convolutional neural network),RCNN (Region with convolutional neural network),VGG16(Visual geometry group 16), VGG19(Visual geometry group 19) for identification of plant through flowers. It also provides the description of medicinal benefits of the flower and the plant. Shape and texture features obtained a accuracy of 96.3% with FRCNN, 94.04% with RCNN, 92.4% with VGG16, and 93.2% with VGG19 when tested in the ratio of 80:20.

articleTitle: Colposcopy Image Classification using Fuzzy Min-Max Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cervical cancer is ranked as fourth most prevalent cancer worldwide among women. Effective treatment can lead to complete cure for early-stage cervical cancer. Colposcopy is a widely used diagnostic tool for cervical cancer; its accuracy depends on the experience of examiner. A fuzzy min-max neural network(FMMN) is used to classify images in medical image analysis. Neuro-fuzzy architecture combines fuzzy logic and deep learning techniques to handle overlapping classes and create precise classification models. The proposed system introduces a novel approach that uses deep learning-based feature extraction in conjunction with an FMMN to accurately classify colposcopy images. Performance of proposed system is evaluated by testing various pre-trained models on the IARC dataset. The best accuracy achieved by GoogleNet is 100%.

articleTitle: IOT Based Smart Food Dehydration and Grinder System for Agricultural Usage
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: India plays an important role in agriculture sector which is the primary source of livelihood about 58% of country's population where dehydration of fruits and vegetables are also considered as a beneficial occupation, Dehydration is a process which removes the moisture content or humidity for increasing the shelf life of fruits and vegetables. This system is an automated process which can be controlled through mobile devices. The system consists of mainly two methods dehydrator and grinder. Once the food is dehydrated, it will produce its greasepaint. The proposed strategy is based on Wi-Fi technology for controlling the grinder system which can be accomplished by Wi-Fi node Mcu (esp8266). The mobile device sends the serial data to node Mcu, it will process the input data according to the program uploaded and accordingly produce the output.

articleTitle: Solving Arithmetic English Word Problems Using Intermediate Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Developing a system to tackle math word problem solving is recognized as a complex undertaking that necessitates machine common sense, including logical inference. Despite the ongoing endeavors devoted to this field, developing a solver system that can effectively handle diverse datasets continues to pose a significant challenge in the present times. This project pioneers the evaluation of the Encoder-Decoder approach as a means of constructing an English language math question-answering system. Unlike methods requiring human feature engineering, this approach has displayed promising potential as a solver for the Chinese language. In our research, we customized the model for the English language, performed assessments using a subset of the MathQA English datasets, and carried out a sequence of experiments with the goal of improving the model's precision and scope.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Authentication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In present authentication systems on the web, users are compelled to interact with identity providers. Initially, they are required to register on a particular website wherein they fill all their details. After this stage, they get a user id and password or token which they can use for accessing the application and their respective features. However, from security point of view, this type of system can be challenging. In such systems, authentication of data is available with the identity providers. It could be hacked to obtain the user passwords and other details. Various current systems track the activity of users and users provide access to sensitive information for the same. For example, access to storage, files, contacts, etc. To make sure that data is available, third-party servers are required which need to be available during authentication. In current, various methods for authentication such as Single-Factor, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), Single Sign-On, Multi-Factor Authentication, etc are used. In this paper, we will study the authentication systems, their advantages and flaws along with the protocols used.

articleTitle: Analysis of Impact of Image Restoration and Segmentation on Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A widely studied problem in computer science is the restoration, segmentation, and classification of images, which involves image processing, computer vision, and machine learning techniques. Deep learning has made significant contributions to this field, bringing machine learning closer to artificial intelligence. Deep learning has a broad range of applications, including in surveillance, healthcare, medicine, and sports. Convolutional neural networks (CNN), a combination of artificial neural networks (ANN) and deep learning techniques, have made incredible advancements in deep learning. This survey compares methods for restoring noisy images, such as wiener filter, wavelet method, and wiener filtering with BM3D technique, using Gaussian blurring and noising methods. The survey also examines the RGB colour model and YCbCr colour model for image segmentation. Image classification is studied using CNN, where the survey discusses various parameters of convolutional neural networks, including activation functions and pooling methods.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning-Based Sustainable Climate Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A climate recognition system (CRS) based on transfer learning (TL) technique has been proposed for multi-classification of collected climatic images based on 4 different climatic classes. MobileNetv2 model along with a simple CNN classifier has been fusion up to develop an efficient and sustainable CRS for recognition and classification of various climatic conditions in different terrains. Rainy, sunny, foggy, and windy climatic classes have been considered for multi-classification which resulted in the best recognition accuracy of 98.75<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> in the case of the sunny climatic class. The proposed work has also discussed the methodological milestones adopted for the conduction of the experiment, with prominent challenges encountered. Additionally, the proposed technology contributes to the provision of sustainable support for education and quality of life. The observation and findings of the proposed work have proved the efficiency, sustainability, and efficacy of the TL approach for developing CRS.

articleTitle: Learning Analytics in Blended Mode During Covid-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Personality and behavior are great factors when considering students' learning strategies. Students tend to utilize their best capacity when the environment around them is comforting and the situation go hand in hand with their personality. Learning analytics is a study based on theories and until recently, was not a topic any researcher would show interest in. During 2019- 2020, a severe change was caused not only to students but the entire education system when the Covid-19 pandemic was caused. Exploring the factors which affected students' performance during and after the pandemic is a topic yet to be researched. This entire study is based on students' feedback on their performance during and after the pandemic has nearly ended

articleTitle: An Automated Combined System for Crop Prediction and Yield Prediction Using Deep Hybrid Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Crop yield prediction and recommendation systems are important for farmers to decide the correct crop for their land. This paper proposed a yield prediction and crop recommendation system that leverages deep learning and machine learning methods. The system aims to assist farmers in the decision of crop selection, planting, and harvesting. The system takes into account various factors, such as conditions of weather, soil quality, and historical yield data, to predict the yield of a particular crop. The proposed system was evaluated on a dataset of crop yield data from several regions of Maharashtra state, and the results show that it can accurately predict crop yields and provide useful recommendations for farmers. The dataset is trained using a combined machine learning and deep learning methods, in which initially it predicts the crop for the current season. Then the predicted crop is used as input to a deep learning model, which recommends its respective yield for that season. The proposed system has been tested on historical crop yield data and weather data for two seasons, and the results show its own accuracy and efficiency for traditional crop management methods. The future scope is to assist farmers by recommending fertilizer and irrigation requirements and pest control measures.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Network based Brain MRI Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is becoming an increasingly important problem for individuals between the ages of 6 and 17. This disorder leads to a neurological condition impacting a person's ability to communicate and connect socially. The symptoms of ASD include despair, anxiety, hyperacidity, and so forth. Individuals can develop severe problems as a result of this. Therefore, a diagnosis in the early stages is reasonably necessary. The most common diagnostic method for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Deep Learning (DL) enables enhanced computational complexity, the capability to handle bigger data sets and high algorithmic efficiency. However, the performance of DL techniques is hugely affected by the data scarcity problem that occurs due to limited or uneven dataset size. Thus, there is a need to increase or balance the dataset size to equalize the qualitative and quantitative results of ASD detection. Therefore, this paper presents the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) for brain MRI data augmentation. The performance of the suggested approach is evaluated on Autism Brain Imaging Exchange (ABIDE-I) dataset.

articleTitle: Secure Data Transmission Design Using 32-Bit Memory Block
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: As technology advances at an ever-increasing rate, the difficulty of protecting data from hackers rises in the advanced world. By using cutting-edge methods, hackers are attempting to get past security measures. Citizens' worries about data privacy are rising as a result. Data breaches can be prevented by using hardware or software. The FPGA board is adaptable and simple to operate. FPGA also offers effectiveness. The study uses software to implement the Advanced Encryption Standard encryption technique. It uses the AES cryptographic security method. AES is implemented by using the 2014.7 ISE Design Suite from Xilinx. The Spartan-6 FPGA displays the results. On the Spartan-6, we addressed the Advanced Encryption Standard Algorithm's implementation and resource requirements.

articleTitle: Smart Health Monitoring System Using Pulse and Temperature Sensor (Sensor-Based Health Observer)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Smart healthcare is crucial for those who require ongoing monitoring that cannot be offered outside of hospitals. Additionally, it is crucial in rural areas where adjacent private clinics may converse with urban hospitals on the health of their patients. This study intends a smart, sensor-based health observer system that notifies the concerned party through SMS while monitoring the patient's state using biomedical sensors. Here, the biomedical sensors are interfaced with a Wi-Fi module controller, which reads the data, and outputs it to an LCD or serial monitor. For a smartphone to show data, SMS must be used. a message sent by the patient's family members to make accessing the patient's information simple. Monitoring the patient at home and regularly checking on their health is a particularly difficult chore in routinely busy work. It is important to periodically check older people's health to prevent serious medical emergencies.

articleTitle: Self Generated Soccer Highlights Using Inflated 3D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Soccer being an international sport have a huge fanbase from all around the world in different time zones and nowadays in this fast-paced world it is difficult to catch up with every match. So, to remain up-to-date fans watch highlight video instead to save up the time. To automate this process video summarization techniques can be used with the help of Deep Learning Algorithms. Our main goal was to develop a model that can summarize an entire soccer match by processing the whole video using Inflated 3D Convolutional Neural Network. Inflated 3D Convolutional Neural Network is used to identify action and motion from throughout the match due to its spatial and temporal features. We used SoccerNet dataset to train our model which has total 500 complete soccer matches which is around 764 hours long in total. We split our data in the ratio of [0.85, 0.1, 0.05] as training, validation, and testing data. Our aim was to generate small clips that highlight the major events such as goals, substitutions, and penalties. These small videos are merged using Video Overlay method and will generate text in between the highlighted video to give that realistic experience. Accuracy of our model is 95%.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Machine Learning Models and Deep Learning Model for Prediction of Car Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: With the widespread usage of automobiles, newly manufactured vehicles are difficult to reach consumers for a variety of reasons, including exorbitant prices, limited availability, financial impossibility, and so on. As a result, the used automotive business is expanding across the board, despite the fact that it is still in its infancy in India and is dominated mostly by the unorganised sector. When purchasing a used car, this makes it easier for fraud to occur. As a result, a model with high precision is required to estimate the price of a used car without considering the client or merchandiser.In this entire article, multiple machine learning and deep learning models were employed to forecast and analyse the usual attributes of the previously owned automotive industry in the nation of India, an escalating nation with an uninformed secondhand automotive buyer market. We checked the important statistical aspects of the data before generating models, showed the data using multiple graphs for improved visualisation, and deleted a number of likely outliers to decrease their impact on the later models. We then used two practical machine learning techniques (linear regression and random forest regression) and a deep learning Artificial Neural Networking model to build and analyse the data. Then, consumers may learn a lot more about used car prices in India, and sellers may find it difficult to keep information hidden in light of our pretty comprehensive model.

articleTitle: An Overview of Design and Implementation of Various Ordered Statistical Methods for Target Detection in RADAR
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In case of target detection, the background environment is not always homogeneous. Rather, most of the times, it is filled with non-homogeneities like multiple targets and reverberation edges. Cell Averaging Constant False Alarm Rate (CA-CFAR) gives better performance in a homogeneous environment, but its performance decreases in the presence of non-homogeneities and in the presence of multiple targets. No other CFARs give the best performance in both homogeneous and Non- homogeneous environments at the same time. Variability Index CFAR (VI-CFAR) is a combined CFAR approach that adapts itself to CA-CFAR, GO-CFAR, or SO-CFAR depending on whether the background environment is homogeneous, has reverberation edges, or has multiple targets, respectively. This adaptability is based on the values of the Mean Ratio (MR) and the Variability index (VI) calculated from the leading or lagging CFAR reference windows. This paper discusses various CFAR processing techniques with their advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach in Melanoma Cancer Stage Detection

articleTitle: An Effective Search Algorithm for Analyzing and Extracting Indian Legal Judgments using NER and Document Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: With the ever-growing population, the number of legal offenses is also increasing yearly. Going through all the legal documentation can be a very exhausting and time demanding process. Today, NLP (Natural Language Processing) is quite capable of processing documents and extracting key information. Owing to daily advancements in technology it's the perfect time to couple data analytic tools with historical data and create a search algorithm. The searching algorithm can discover an analogous historical case to the one we're working on and give the user access to all the similar legal cases. In this project, the primary attempt is to leverage Knowledge graph and NLP (Natural Language Processing) to construct a legal search algorithm that assists in searching it across a big data corpus created using multiple sources.This study aims to design a semantic search model for the legal domain to facilitate searching of similar judgments by leveraging the power of knowledge graph. Designing a legal system is a very nation-specific task to be carried out because legal terminology shows great variations when it comes to judgment and other legal documents. This study is supposed to produce a smart enough search mechanism that can find similar cases and assist in the faster proceeding of the trial.

abstract: This paper covers the basics and fundamentals of emerging new technologies and evolutions in 5G technology.
